acanthocobitis-botia.name: Zipper loach
notes: Item 1: "Dulu ikan ini lama dianggap" is awkward; use "Ikan ini lama dianggap" or "Dulu dianggap".
Item 5: "beech, oak" are left in English; use "daun kering beech (Fagus), ek" or similar.
Item 5: "aufwuchs" is left untranslated with no gloss; add "(lapisan alga dan mikroorganisme)".
Item 5: "setup" is used repeatedly; "tata letak akuarium" or "aquascape" is more natural.

acanthocobitis-zonalternans.name: Zipper Loach
notes: Item 2: the neotype locality quote is left in English ('4 kilometers south of Amphoe Mae Ramat on road 1085 ... Tak Province, Salween basin, Thailand'). Translate the descriptive words, e.g. '4 kilometer di selatan Amphoe Mae Ramat di jalan 1085 ... Provinsi Tak, cekungan Salween, Thailand'. Keep the place names.
Item 5: 'daun kering beech, oak' leaves the English names in place. Use 'daun beech (Fagus) dan ek' or add a short gloss.
Item 5: 'setup' and 'hill stream' stay in English. 'Setup' is common, but 'tata letak/penataan akuarium' and 'akuarium tipe sungai pegunungan berarus' read more naturally.
Item 5: 'aufwuchs' is left untranslated. Add a gloss such as 'aufwuchs (lapisan alga dan biofilm)'.

acanthopsoides-molobrion.name: Dwarf Horse-faced Loach
notes: Item 11: "seorang hobiis, Mark Duffill" names a forum member and drops the "SF member" attribution; consider a neutral "seorang hobiis" without the name.
Item 12: "Lokasi tipe" and "duri sub-okular" are stiff; "lokalitas tipe" and "duri di bawah mata" read more naturally.
Item 12: "Ikan hias" is fine, but "tuberkel kawin" and "kromatofor" could use a short gloss for hobbyist readers.

acanthopsoides-robertsi.name: Dwarf Horseface Loach
notes: "5,2 sampai 7,2 dalam panjang kepala" and "2 sampai 2,5 dalam panjang kepala" read awkwardly. Rephrase as "5,2–7,2 kali dalam panjang kepala" or "panjang kepala 5,2–7,2 kali diameter mata".
"batu yang halus terkikis air" is clumsy. Use "batu yang halus karena terkikis air" or "batu sungai yang halus".
"bintil-bintil kawin kecil (breeding tubercle)": "bintil pemijahan" is more usual; the bracketed English is fine.
"danau tapal kuda" for oxbow is acceptable but could be "danau tapal kuda (oxbow)" or "kolam bekas meander sungai" for clarity.

acantopsis-dialuzona.name: Horseface loach
notes: Item 12: "sirip ekor yang sedikit bercabang" and "sirip ekor bercabang atau berlekuk dalam" translate "forked" with "bercabang". That also means "branched" (as in branched rays), so it is ambiguous. Use "bercagak" or "berpangkal dua" instead.
Item 3: "sebagian besar (kalaupun ada)" renders "a significant percentage (if any)" as "most", which is stronger than the source. Use "persentase yang signifikan (kalaupun ada)".
Item 3: "dari setiap kajian yang mendetail" is a bit loose. Use "dari kajian yang mendetail".
Item 6: "batu yang tergerus air" is awkward for "water-worn rocks". Use "batu sungai yang halus terkikis air" or "batu kali".

acrochordonichthys-gyrinus.name: Falcate Chameleon Catfish
notes: "teman setangki" (items 1, 8) is slightly unnatural. "ikan penghuni akuarium yang sama" or "tankmate" would be more usual for Indonesian hobbyists.
"tanpa lipatan daging" (item 9) is a bit literal for "fleshy flap". "tanpa lipatan berdaging" reads more naturally.

acrochordonichthys-rugosus.name: Asian Banjo Catfish
notes: Item 2/16: "Risiko Rendah (Least Concern)" is a slightly non-standard rendering of the IUCN category. "Berisiko Rendah" or "Risiko Rendah" with the English term is acceptable, but keep it consistent with the Indonesian IUCN usage.
Item 7: "kimia air yang naik-turun" is a bit stiff. Consider "parameter air yang berfluktuasi".
Item 8: "Kayu dan akar yang sudah lama terendam" for "Aged driftwood" slightly shifts the meaning. Consider "kayu apung yang sudah matang/tua (driftwood)".
Item 12: "Meskipun sebenarnya tidak suka bergerombol" is a bit stronger than "not really gregarious". Consider "kurang bersifat bergerombol".

acrochordonichthys-septentrionalis.name: Mae Klong Chameleon Catfish
notes: "stres dalam bentuk tertentu" is stiff and slightly unclear for "stressed in some way". Use "mengalami stres/tertekan oleh sebab tertentu".
"batu dan kerikil sungai yang halus terkikis air" is awkward for "water-worn rocks and pebbles". Use "batu dan kerikil sungai yang bulat/halus terkikis air", or simply "batu dan kerikil sungai".
"pori aksila" is very technical. Consider adding the English term in brackets, "pori aksila (axillary pore)".
"pengaturan seperti ini membantu" is a loose rendering of "such an arrangement provides assistance". Use "pengelompokan seperti ini membantu".
"Seperti kerabatnya satu genus" is clumsy. Use "Seperti spesies lain dalam genusnya".

agamyxis-pectinifrons.name: Raphael tutul
notes: Item 1: 'Max size: 150 mm SL (6 in)' became '15 cm SL' – fine, but item 3 'Polygonium sp.' etc unchanged; no issue. Real issue in item 4: volume stated as 'sekitar 108 liter' with no tank height given; acceptable. Main issue: item 2 'Region Loreto' should be 'Wilayah/Departemen Loreto' (Region is untranslated English).
Item 2: 'Batas pasti sebaran alaminya masih agak belum jelas' is awkward; use 'masih kurang jelas'.
Item 2: 'Lokasi tipe' should be 'lokalitas tipe' (standard taxonomic term); 'Equador' in the quote is fine.

Item 3: 'mengalir 'sedimen terlarut membuat air keruh' – source says 'reducing visibility'; fine, but 'polong-polongan' for 'leguminous species' is okay. 'padang apung' is a coined term; keep English in brackets only once consistently.

Item 7: 'omnivora generalis' is stiff; use 'omnivora dan tidak pemilih (generalis)'. 'Tubifex' translated as 'cacing sutra' is OK but 'pakan buatan' for 'prepared foods' should be 'pakan olahan/pabrikan'.
Item 11: 'sisik keras (scute)' – scutes are bony plates, not scales; use 'lempeng tulang (scute)'. 'klad' is unusual; use 'kelompok monofiletik (clade)'.
Item 11: 'memperkeras suara' mistranslates 'projection of the noise'; should be 'memancarkan/menyalurkan suara'.
Item 11: 'kerabat segenusnya' – 'congener' fine; but 'Region'/'lele driftwood' fine. 'konon' for 'ostensibly' adds hearsay nuance; use 'tampaknya/dengan alasan'.

akysis-ephippifer.name: Akysis ephippifer
notes: "mudah dipelihara oleh penghobi yang cukup berpengalaman": "any decent fishkeeper" means almost any reasonably competent keeper; consider "penghobi yang kompeten/pada umumnya" so it doesn't imply experience is required.
"dalam 30 cm": for tank depth, use "panjang/lebar depan-belakang" or "kedalaman" more naturally, e.g. "30 cm (lebar) x 20 cm (tinggi) x 30 cm (dalam)" could be clearer.
"gua": hobbyists usually say "gua-gua kecil" or "shelter/tempat sembunyi"; the plural "caves" is not reflected.
"sirip ekor yang sedikit berlekuk (emarginate)": "emarginate" means a shallow notch; "sedikit" is acceptable, but "berlekuk dangkal" is more precise.
"Data Deficient (Kekurangan Data)": the standard Indonesian IUCN term is "Data Kurang"; use "Data Kurang (Data Deficient)".
"kutu air" for daphnia: hobbyists often use "kutu air" for Daphnia, though "Daphnia" is also common; this is fine but could add "(daphnia)".

akysis-hendricksoni.name: Hendrickson's Stream Catfish
notes: Item 19: "Wakil Rektor" for "Vice-Chancellor" is a questionable equivalent (a vice-chancellor is closer to a rector or head). Use "Rektor" or "Wakil Kanselir", or keep the English title.
Item 14: "hillstream loach dari famili Balitoridae" adds "hillstream", which is not in the source. Use "lohok/loach balitorid" or "famili Balitoridae" only.
Item 5: "sungai kecil yang cukup besar (lebar sekitar 10 m)" is contradictory and awkward. Use "anak sungai yang cukup lebar (sekitar 10 m)" or just "sungai".
Item 9: "penghobi yang cukup berpengalaman" reads more demanding than "any decent fishkeeper". Use "penghobi yang kompeten" or "penghobi pada umumnya".
Item 8: "moss" is left in English. Use "lumut (moss)" or "berbagai jenis lumut air".
Item 19: "kysis = kantong" for "bladder" is imprecise. "Kandung" or "kantung" would be better, since the reference is to the swim bladder.
Item 12: "jentik kaca (glassworm)" is a loose rendering of the glassworm (Chaoborus larva). Hobbyists usually say "cacing kaca" or "jentik lonceng/kaca", so check the term.

akysis-heterurus.name: Lele Akysis
notes: Item 4: "depan-belakang 30 cm" is awkward for tank depth; use "dalam 30 cm" or "lebar 30 cm x tinggi 20 cm x dalam 30 cm".
Item 4: "gua-gua kecil sebagai tempat bersembunyi" adds "kecil" and "sebagai tempat bersembunyi", which the source does not say; use "gua" only.
Item 3: the gloss after "unculiferous" ("yaitu tonjolan kecil yang permukaannya dipenuhi tonjolan halus seperti kait") is not in the source; remove it or shorten it to "berunculi".

akysis-maculipinnis.name: Spotfin Stream Catfish
notes: Item 14: "alur-alur melingkar di sekitar lubangnya" for "radial grooves" is wrong, because melingkar means circular. Use "alur-alur yang memancar dari lubangnya" or similar.
Item 8: "moss", "beech" and "oak" are left in English. Use "lumut" or "moss" with a gloss, and "daun beech/ek" with a gloss.
Item 15: "air yang sudah diendapkan" for "aged water" is slightly off. "air yang sudah didiamkan/diendapkan (aged)" is more natural, and "diffuser" could get a local gloss.
Item 13: "wajib cari tahu dulu dengan benar" is colloquial for a handbook. Use "wajib dipelajari dulu dengan cermat".

akysis-pulvinatus.name: Kra stream catfish
notes: "betina yang sedang bertelur" for "gravid female": gravid means carrying eggs, not yet spawning. Use "betina yang sedang bunting telur" or "penuh telur".
"alur-alur melingkar di sekitar lubangnya" for "radial grooves at the pore": radial means grooves radiating outward. Use "alur-alur yang memancar dari lubang".
"batu-batu sungai yang halus" for "water-worn rocks": better as "batu sungai yang halus/membulat karena terkikis air".
Item 8: "hillstream loach (balitorid)" is fine, but "tumbuh terlalu besar" would read more naturally as "terlalu besar saat dewasa".

akysis-variegatus.name: Akysis variegatus
notes: Item 1: "unculiferous plaques or tubercles" is rendered "lempeng atau tuberkel berunkulus (tonjolan kecil seperti duri)". "Unculiferous" means bearing unculi (horny, spine-like cell structures). "berunkulus" is a non-standard coinage, and the added explanation is a gloss the source doesn't contain. Use a clearer rendering such as "berunkuli", or a simple explanation.

Item 1: "Nasal barbel shorter than head length" should be "sungut hidung" with a clear comparison to head length. "Large dark blotches on lower part of body" is fine. Check that "Bagian bawah tubuh berbercak gelap besar" is not misread, and consider "bercak gelap besar".

Item 2: The English locality statement is contradictory: "Northern Borneo and Mekong basin" versus "known only from Citarum, Java". The translation keeps this faithfully. No fix needed except that "1960's" is correctly given as "1960-an".

Item 3: "kedalaman 30 cm" for tank depth is better as "lebar 30 cm x tinggi 20 cm x dalam 30 cm", or use "panjang x lebar x tinggi". "gua" would be more natural as "gua-gua kecil" or "gua buatan" (ornamen gua).
Item 6: "makan dengan sangat lahap dan heboh" is colloquial for "voraciously and crazily". Consider "sangat rakus" for a handbook register.
Item 5: "kutu air" for daphnia is acceptable, but hobbyists commonly use "daphnia" or "kutu air (Daphnia)". Consider adding it.

akysis-varius.name: Akysis varius
notes: Item 16: "Pola warna dewasa sudah terbentuk sempurna baru 23 hari kemudian" reverses the nuance. The English "after just 23 days" means it was fast, but "baru" reads as late. Use "hanya dalam 23 hari" or "sudah terbentuk sempurna hanya setelah 23 hari".
Items 1, 17, 18: "sirip ekor tegak (truncate)" is a questionable rendering. "Tegak" does not describe a caudal fin shape. Use "sirip ekor terpotong rata (truncate)".
Item 1: "Variable stream catfish" is left in English in the running text. Add a local gloss such as "lele sungai variabel" or keep it clearly marked as a trade name.
Item 17: "alat bisa (venom)" is awkward. "Kelenjar bisa" or "struktur penyuntik bisa" is more natural.

akysis-vespa.name: Wasp Catfish
notes: #8: "(misalnya lumut Java)" is not in the source. Delete it or keep only "berbagai jenis lumut".
#14: "hillstream loach dari famili Balitoridae" adds "hillstream", which the source doesn't have. Use "lonjong/loach balitorid" or "loach Balitoridae" without the addition.
#14: "Lele akysid lain ... direkomendasikan untuk lapisan bawah akuarium" is slightly awkward. "Ikan lele akysid" would be more natural.

allenbatrachus-grunniens.name: Ikan kodok
notes: Item 2: "menggerutu/mendengkur" for Latin 'grunting' is imprecise. Use "mendengus" or "menggeram" (grunting sound), and give one term rather than two.
Item 1: the opening "Freshwater toadfish" is left in English. Give an Indonesian name or gloss first, e.g. "Ikan kodok air tawar (freshwater toadfish)".
Item 5: "Spesies ini cukup umum di dunia akuarium" is slightly vague. "Dalam dunia akuarium hobi" or "di kalangan hobiis" would sound more natural.

amatitlania-nigrofasciata.name: Convict Cichlid
notes: Item 6: "Idealnya sedikit di atas netral (basa)" – "Somewhere on the alkaline side of neutral" means on the alkaline side; "sedikit" (slightly) adds a nuance, and the bracket is clumsy. Use "Idealnya di sisi basa dari netral".
Item 11: "burayaknya tidak mudah disalurkan" – "dispose of" means getting rid of or selling the fry; "disalurkan" is vague. Use "dijual atau dilepaskan" / "sulit dihabiskan".
Item 10: "Burayak" is used for the eggs' hatchlings and for free-swimming fry, and "Anakan" appears for the same young later. Keep the terms consistent.
Item 10: "Untuk ikan sekecil itu, mereka sangat agresif" – "sekecil itu" has no clear referent; use "Untuk ikan sekecil ini" / "seukuran ini".
Item 7: "kondisi ikan bisa berkembang optimal" – "kondisi berkembang" is awkward; use "agar kondisi ikan prima".
Item 10: "Kondisikan ikan" – the hobby term for conditioning broodstock is "dikondisikan/diberi pakan pematangan gonad"; "merangsang pemijahan" is fine.
Item 5: "kayu bogwood" is redundant; use "kayu bogwood (kayu apung/akar kayu)" or just "bogwood".
Item 1/11: "menjadi sangat ganas saat berbiak" – "berbiak" for fish is better as "memijah" for consistency with the rest of the text.

ambastaia-nigrolineata.name: Black-lined Loach
notes: Item 9: 'karena Ambastaia spp. ikan yang penuh rasa ingin tahu' lacks the copula; write 'merupakan ikan yang penuh rasa ingin tahu'.
Item 7: 'riam' for 'riffles' suggests rapids or waterfalls; 'bagian berarus deras dan dangkal' or 'riak' is closer.
Item 12: 'ikan lele' for 'catfishes' usually means Clarias; 'berbagai jenis catfish' or 'ikan berkumis' is better for ornamental catfish.

ambastaia-sidthimunki.name: Botia sidthimunki
notes: Item 6: "karena Ambastaia spp. ikan yang penasaran" is missing a verb. Write "karena Ambastaia spp. adalah ikan yang penasaran".
Item 11: "indukan dewasanya" adds the idea of breeders. The source says only "adult specimens", so use "ikan dewasanya".
Item 11: the report link ("available here") is turned into "Mark juga menulis laporan lengkap". The reader can no longer find the report, so keep a pointer to it.
Item 3: the acknowledgement "Thanks to Kamphol Udomritthiruj" is dropped. Restore it, or make sure the source credit is kept in the "K. Udomritthiruj, komunikasi pribadi" citation.
Item 12: "Pertunjukan seperti ini" for "Such displays" reads oddly. Use "Tampilan seperti ini" or "Perilaku semacam ini".
Item 6: "batu dan kerikil yang halus bekas tergerus air" is clumsy. Use "batu dan kerikil halus yang terkikis air".

amblyceps-foratum.name: Amblyceps foratum
notes: "mata ... terletak di sisi atas kepala": 'dorsolaterally situated' is better rendered as "terletak di sisi punggung-lateral (dorsolateral) kepala"; "sisi atas" loses the lateral component.
"menimbulkan bengkak yang cukup parah": 'much swelling' is rendered a bit weaker; "pembengkakan hebat" would be closer.
"Least Concern/Risiko Rendah": the standard Indonesian term is "Risiko Rendah (Least Concern)"; keep the format consistent with the bracket convention.
"foto mini pertama" for 'first thumbnail': "gambar mini/thumbnail pertama" is more natural.
"Dideskripsikan oleh": "Dideskripsikan oleh" is acceptable but "Deskripsi oleh" or "Dijelaskan oleh" is more natural in a spec list.
"ruas tulang belakang" for vertebrae: "vertebra" or "ruas tulang belakang (vertebra)" is the usual term.

amblypharyngodon-chulabhornae.name: Princess Carplet
notes: Item 5: "siklus nitrogennya belum matang" is fine, but "Paling cocok dipelihara" is a slight shift from "Best maintained"; acceptable. Main issue: "ikan ikutan (bycatch)" is unnatural; use "ikan tangkapan sampingan" or "ikan campuran yang ikut terbawa".
Item 1/3: "Princess carplet" left untranslated with no local name; consider adding a descriptive Indonesian rendering or keeping it in italics/quotes as a trade name.
Item 2: "Lokasi tipe" is fine, but the type locality text is left in English ("Province"); consider "Provinsi" or keep as a quoted citation consistently.
Item 4: "Panjang standar: 4 cm" drops the precision of 40 mm; write "40 mm (4 cm)" or "4,0 cm".
Item 5: "Filter tidak perlu terlalu kuat karena ikan ini kebanyakan berasal dari..." is slightly awkward; use "karena ikan ini umumnya berasal dari perairan yang tenang".
Item 8: "tidak mudah stres" replaces "less nervous" (more skittish); prefer "tidak mudah gugup/penakut".
Item 7: "kutu air" for Daphnia is acceptable but the common hobby term is "kutu air (Daphnia)"; consider keeping "Daphnia" explicitly.

amphilophus-labiatus.name: Red Devil
notes: Item 11: "belang" (barred) and "belang-belang tidak beraturan (piebald)" are too close to tell apart. Use "bergaris/berpita vertikal" for barred.
Item 5: "saat sedang heboh" is informal. Use something like "saat sedang sangat aktif/agresif".
Item 3: "limbah kotoran mentah" is awkward. Use "limbah tinja/kotoran mentah" or "limbah kotoran yang belum diolah".

anabas-testudineus.name: Ikan Betok
notes: Item 9: "mastacembelid (sidat/belut berduri)": sidat is Anguilla, a different fish. Use "tilan" or "belut duri".
Item 12: "peternakan komersial" for commercial farms: peternakan means livestock. Use "usaha budidaya ikan komersial" or "pembudidaya".
Item 12: "data deficient" is left in English quotes with a gloss. This is acceptable, but "data kurang (data deficient)" would read more naturally.

anentome-helena.name: Keong Assassin
notes: "loach atau buntal": acceptable, but could use common Indonesian names, e.g. "ikan botia atau buntal" for loaches.
"belalainya": "trunk" is better rendered as "proboscis"/"belalai" is fine; consider "probosis" only if needed (very minor).

aphyocharax-anisitsi.name: Bloodfin tetra
notes: Item 3: "Ikan ini mungkin menggigiti sirip teman setangki yang bersirip panjang atau gerakannya lambat" is ambiguous. Say "teman setangki yang bersirip panjang atau berenang lambat".
Item 8: "paling tampak betah" is awkward. Use "paling cocok/tampak paling betah".
Items 3, 11, 14: "teman setangki" is slightly stiff. "Penghuni akuarium lain" or "ikan lain" is more natural.
Item 14: "bertenaga aerator" for "air-powered" is imprecise. Use "digerakkan udara dari aerator".
Item 14: "burayak" is correct but "hasilnya sampai beberapa ratus ekor burayak" is wordy. Simplify to "beberapa ratus ekor burayak".
Item 13: "Para akuaris" and "kesempatan langka" for "unique opportunity" are acceptable. "Fungsi variasi warna" for "purpose" is fine. "Dikromatisme" could use a gloss.
Item 4: "si Bloodfin tetra" adds a colloquial tone not in the source. Use "yaitu Bloodfin tetra".
Item 12: "sirip anusnya" is stiff. "Sirip dubur" is the usual term.
Item 13: "sirip anus" has the same problem. Use "sirip dubur".

apteronotus-albifrons.name: Black Ghost
notes: Item 8: "makin kurus dan akhirnya mati" adds a death outcome. The source says only "wastes away". Use "makin kurus" or "menyusut kondisinya".
Items 1 and 2: "separuh bagian utara" for "upper half" is acceptable, but "bagian utara" alone may be more natural. Paraguay is in the south, so the phrase is slightly inaccurate in the source too.

apteronotus-leptorhynchus.name: Brown Ghost Knifefish
notes: "rutin diimpor" for "regularly stocked": slightly shifts meaning (stocked = available in shops). Consider "rutin tersedia" or "rutin dijual".
"Apteronotus leptorhynchus berwarna keemasan" with no article or noun: reads awkwardly. Consider "seekor Apteronotus leptorhynchus ..." or add "ikan".

astronotus-ocellatus.name: Ikan Oscar
notes: Item 1: 'Ukuran maksimal: 35 cm SL' / 'mencapai 35 cm SL' – 350 mm = 35 cm is correct, no issue; but see other items.
Item 12: 'cacing sutra' for tubifex is acceptable, but 'karnivora sejati' for 'serious carnivores' is fine; main issue: 'Oscar sangat menuntut kualitas kimia air' is okay.
Item 14: 'pastikan tetap memilih jenis-jenis dari Amerika Selatan juga' is slightly awkward; better 'pilih hanya jenis dari Amerika Selatan'.
Item 17: 'enam ekor anakan atau lebih' – 'half-a-dozen or more' fine; 'burayak' for fry is acceptable but 'benih' is more common among hobbyists.

Item 18: 'dibuahi oleh jantan dengan berenang di atasnya' – original says male swims over to fertilize; acceptable. 'Oscar bisa pilih-pilih dalam memilih pasangan' is repetitive; use 'sangat selektif dalam memilih pasangan'.
Item 19: 'bersifat kamuflase' for 'cryptic' colour pattern is fine but inconsistent with 'kriptik' used elsewhere; 'tribus dugaan' is awkward, use 'tribus yang diduga (putative)'.
Item 2: 'Area berenang: Atas dan tengah' ok; the source 'Minimum tank size 65 gallons (about 250 litres)' conversion: 65 US gal ≈ 246 L, OK.
Item 18: '100 gallon (about 380 litres)' fine.
Item 12: 'cacing darah' for bloodworms fine; but 'Meskipun sebagian orang menyarankan... pakan hidup' fine. Item 3: 'Populasi liar hasil introduksi' fine.
Item 6: Omitted the US gallon conversion — fine per instructions.

astyanax-mexicanus.name: Blind Cave Tetra
notes: Item 10: "pada sore atau malam hari" adds "sore"; the source says only "in the evening" ("pada malam hari").
Item 10: "Biasanya mereka sudah memijah" adds "Biasanya" (usually), which softens the source's "They should have spawned". Use "Mereka seharusnya sudah memijah".
Items 5 and 10: "setup" is left as English. "Penataan akuarium" or "set-up" would be more natural.

atractosteus-spatula.name: Ikan aligator
notes: #2: "hingga ke selatan sampai negara bagian Veracruz" is redundant. Use "hingga ke selatan sampai negara bagian Veracruz" -> "hingga ke negara bagian Veracruz di selatan".

#8: "ikan yang tidak agresif dengan ukuran serupa yang tidak muat di mulutnya" is ambiguous because of the stacked "yang". Rephrase, e.g. "ikan non-agresif berukuran serupa yang terlalu besar untuk muat di mulutnya".

atyopsis-moluccensis.name: Udang bambu
notes: Item 2: "finely grated dry food" translated as "pakan kering yang dihaluskan" - acceptable, but "cyclops beku" could be clarified as "cyclops beku" (fine); "partikel melayang" for "floating material" is fine.
Item 3: "kipas tangannya" ("hand fans") is awkward; use "kipas di capitnya" or "kipas capit". Also "capit" for "claws" and "kaki jalan" are okay, but "ujung ... kaki jalan" for "end limbs" is vague.
Item 3: "diam di tempat yang berarus" is slightly awkward; better "menempatkan diri di aliran arus".
Item 5: "cukup merepotkan" is weaker than "connected with some expenditure" (butuh biaya/upaya cukup besar); consider "memerlukan upaya dan biaya tertentu".
Item 1/3: "Moluccan mountain rock shrimp" and "Gabon giant fan shrimp" left in English; consider adding Indonesian names (e.g., "udang kipas raksasa Gabon") with English in brackets.

auriglobus-modestus.name: Buntal Emas
notes: "Pernah ada kiriman" / "Belakangan baru diketahui": fine in meaning, but "A shipment ... was received" implies the shop received it; consider "Kiriman ... diterima" for fidelity."
"ikan lele-lelean (catfish)": catfish is simply "lele" or "ikan lele/catfish"; "lele-lelean" is misleading since many catfish are not true lele."
"ikan sili (spiny eel)": "sili" is not a standard hobby term; use "spiny eel" or "tilan" (Mastacembelus)."
"ikan pisau (knifefish)": hobbyists usually say "knifefish" or "ikan pisau/belida"; acceptable but check consistency."
"Yang berlaku terhadap spesies ikan lain juga berlaku terhadap sesama jenisnya": awkward; better "Hal yang sama berlaku terhadap sesama buntal emas."
"kurang ajar" for "insolent" is too harsh/colloquial; use "lancang" or "agresif"."
"bukan pemilih pakan": "food specialists" means specialised feeders; better "bukan pemakan spesialis".

badis-khwae.name: Badis khwae
notes: Item 7: 'Tubifex' translated as 'cacing sutra' – fine, but the sentence says bloodworm should be omitted while the previous paragraph recommends 'cacing darah' as a regular food; this contradiction exists in the source, so keep it, though 'kutu air' for Daphnia is acceptable. No real fix needed here.

Item 11: 'extended first few dorsal rays/pectoral fins' became 'beberapa jari-jari sirip punggung pertama/sirip dada yang memanjang'; the wording is ambiguous, so change it to 'beberapa jari-jari pertama sirip punggung/sirip dada'.

Item 11: 'Prior to 2002 ... just five species' and 'erection of no less than ten new species' are fine, but 'less involved parental behaviour' became 'perilaku pengasuhan induk yang lebih sederhana'. Prefer 'kurang intensif'.

Item 11: 'B. dibruensis' vs the source 'B. dubruensis' – the spelling changes between mentions. This is in the source, but the translator should keep each spelling as the source has it. The translation did this, so no action is needed.
Item 8: 'Certainly do not combine' became 'Jelas jangan dicampur', which is stilted. Use 'Tentu jangan dicampur'.
Item 10: 'rival males will become increasingly combative' became 'makin sering berkelahi'. Use 'makin agresif'.
Item 1: 'a badid' became 'anggota famili Badidae', which is fine, but items 6 and 11 use 'badid' as a term. Keep the term the same throughout.
Item 4: the volume '54 litres' is correct, but 'sekitar 54 liter' is fine. No issue.

badis-ruber.name: Red Badis
notes: Item 6: English says 'Temperature: 15–25°C' but 'Set it to around 20–24°C'; fine. But 'Prefers neutral to slightly alkaline' ok. Real issue: 'Air di Myanmar utara umumnya lunak' fine. Main issue is item 11: 'extended first few dorsal rays/pectoral fins in males' became 'beberapa jari-jari sirip punggung pertama/sirip dada yang memanjang' - ok; but 'Dario ... less involved parental behaviour' ok.
Item 11: 'Badis dilbruensis' vs 'B. dubruensis' fine as source. 'B. badis ... hanya pita vertikal yang samar' ok.
Item 7: 'Daphnia' translated as 'kutu air' - acceptable; 'Tubifex' as 'cacing sutra' is fine. 'chironomid' left untranslated; use 'larva Chironomus/jentik' with cacing darah.
Item 8: 'Corydoras kerdil (pygmy)' and 'characin' 'cyprinid' left as English terms; prefer 'ikan karasin', 'kecil/kerdil'. 'Loricariidae kecil' fine.
Item 8: 'sifatnya penyendiri' for 'retiring nature' means loner; better 'pemalu/tidak menonjol'. Contradicts later 'agresif' sense slightly.

Item 8: 'Dalam kondisi seperti itu sebaiknya hanya beli sepasang' - 'in these cases' refers to smaller tanks; ok. 'Jelas jangan dicampur' is awkward for 'Certainly do not combine'; use 'Jangan sekali-kali dicampur'.
Item 3: 'danau tapal kuda (ox-bow lake)' fine. 'ikan penghuni dasar' fine.

Item 1: 'dari Sungai Ayeyarwady dan Sittaung hingga ke selatan sampai Tenasserim' redundant 'hingga ke selatan sampai'; also 'badid' / 'badis' wording inconsistent ('anggota famili Badidae' vs 'badid').

badis-siamensis.name: Badis Siam
notes: Item 8: 'suitable species found in the region include.' is truncated in the source; the translation silently turns it into a complete sentence ('ada spesies yang cocok dari wilayah tersebut'). The meaning is intact, but the gap should be handled.

Item 8: 'southwest Thailand' is translated as 'Thailand barat daya'. This is acceptable, but note that item 1 says 'pesisir barat' and the Peninsular region is better described as 'Thailand bagian barat daya'.

Item 11: 'extended first few dorsal rays/pectoral fins' is translated as 'beberapa jari-jari sirip punggung pertama/sirip dada yang memanjang'. This is ambiguous. Use 'beberapa jari-jari pertama sirip punggung/sirip dada yang memanjang'.

Item 11: 'B. badis can be told apart from B. kanabos ... only faint or indistinct vertical bars' is translated as 'hanya garis tegak yang samar'. Use 'pita/palang tegak' for 'bars' rather than 'garis' in order to keep the distinction from 'lines'.

Item 11: 'B. kyar was found to represent the sister group to either the B. ruber or B. badis/B. assamensis clades' is translated as 'kelompok saudara dari klad ... '. Keep the usage consistent: the translation mixes 'kelompok' and 'klad' for 'group' and 'clade'.
Item 11: 'B. dubruensis' and 'B. dibruensis' are spelled differently in the source. The translation keeps both. Check for consistency against the reference (dilbruensis).

Item 7: 'bloodworm' is translated as 'cacing darah' and then 'chironomid larvae (bloodworm) and/or Tubifex' as 'cacing sutra'. This is fine, but the earlier recommendation to feed bloodworm regularly contradicts the later advice to omit it. The contradiction is in the source; consider flagging it. Also 'kutu air' for Daphnia is acceptable.
Item 10: 'Other species are best omitted' is translated as 'Sebaiknya tidak ada spesies lain'. This is acceptable, but 'burayak' for fry is less common among hobbyists than 'anakan'/'larva'.

bagarius-suchus.name: Crocodile Catfish
notes: Item 1/10: "punggung tulang yang tajam" / "punggung tulang tajam" mistranslates "ridges" (literally a back-bone); use "rusuk/lunas/gerigi tajam" or "tonjolan memanjang yang tajam".
Item 10: "punggung atau tonjolan besar" for "ridges or humps" is confusing (punggung = back); use "rusuk/lunas atau tonjolan besar".

Item 1/10: "Tengkorak yang terbuka dan kasar berkerut" and "permukaan atas tengkorak bertulang dan pelat predorsal yang kasar berkerut dan terbuka" garble the structure: rugose applies to the cranium dorsal surface; say "permukaan atas tengkorak yang kasar berkerut" and "pelat predorsal terbuka" separately.
Item 10: "pangkal awal sirip adiposa" is awkward for "adipose fin origin"; use "titik awal pangkal sirip adiposa".
Item 1: "lele sisorid" - Bagarius is not a true lele (Clariidae); better "ikan keli/patin-patinan sisorid" or "catfish sisorid" with a note.

Item 10: "subfamili Sisoridae" - Sisoridae is a family (English says 'putative subfamily', but the term is odd); keep as source but ensure the 'diduga' placement reads correctly: "subfamili Sisorinae yang diduga" is not needed, just reorder.
Item 7: "ikan mas koki kecil" - 'goldfish' is "ikan mas koki" fine, but "cacing darah" for chironomid larvae and "udang sungai" ok; "heterodon" should be "heterodonta" (markedly heterodont).

bagarius-vegrandis.name: Goonch Catfish
notes: Item 1: "lele sisorid" is acceptable, but the sentence "jauh lebih kecil daripada Bagarius lainnya" would read more naturally as "dibandingkan Bagarius lain"; minor.
Item 1/6: "catatan B. bagarius ... merujuk pada spesies ini" is a bit literal; "catatan" could be "laporan temuan" for natural hobby/scientific reading.
Item 2: Type locality in quotes is left in English; acceptable, but consider translating "province" or keeping as is consistently; minor.
Item 4: "remis" for mussels and "kerang" for cockles are fine, but "mau makan" is slightly informal; consider "memakan".
Item 6: "heterodon" is a rare term; consider "heterodont (gigi bervariasi bentuk)" for readability.
Item 6: "dapat menyebabkan sakit" is awkward; use "dapat menyebabkan keracunan/gangguan kesehatan".

bagarius-yarrelli.name: Goonch
notes: Item 1: "lele sisorid" is awkward. Sisorid catfish are not lele (Clarias), so use "ikan lele sisorid" or just "ikan sisorid (catfish)".
Item 3: "arus putih (jeram)" is a literal rendering of "white water". Use "arus deras berbusa" or "jeram berbuih".
Item 8: "heterodon" is a non-standard term. Use "heterodont" or explain it as "bentuk gigi yang berbeda-beda".
Item 5: "harus dianggap wajib" is redundant. Use "wajib dipenuhi" or "mutlak diperlukan".
Item 2: "Semenanjung Malaysia" is acceptable, but "Lokasi tipenya" is better as "Lokalitas tipe", the usual term.
Item 6: "mau menerima" is stiff. Use "mau memakan".

bagrichthys-hypselopterus.name: Black Lancer
notes: Item 9: 'Although they possess a small mouth it is wide' is translated 'Mulutnya memang kecil tetapi lebar' - fine, but 'Meski begitu... tetapi kalau' is clumsy; the source says the fish is not a threat because of the mouth, so the logic is blurred. Rephrase more clearly.
Item 1: 'Least Concern' translated as 'Risiko Rendah' - the standard Indonesian term is 'Berisiko Rendah' or 'Resiko Rendah'; use consistently (also item 12).
Item 1: '400 mm or 15.7" SL' - the SL (standard length) is not explained; consider 'panjang standar (SL)'.

Item 12: 'hypselopterus berarti bersirip tinggi atau panjang' - source says 'deep or long finned'; acceptable but 'nama genus ini hanya dipakai' wrongly repeats 'genus' where source speaks of the name 'bagre' being used - clarify that 'bagre' is the word used for African and Asian species.
Item 12: '247000 km2' should be written '247.000 km²' in Indonesian number format.
Item 7: 'memakan detritus' is OK but 'detritivorous' implies a detritivore; use 'pemakan detritus (detritivor)'.
Item 1 vs 2: Common name 'Black Lancer Catfish' left in English while item 9 uses 'Black lancer' - keep consistent.
Item 3/4: 'in fluviis' left untranslated Latin phrase; fine, but add '(di sungai-sungai)' for readers.

bagrichthys-macracanthus.name: Bagrichthys macracanthus
notes: Item 8: "Pelihara satu jantan bersama 3 betina atau lebih" is fine, but "Damai terhadap spesies yang menghuni bagian lain akuarium" is OK; the real issue is in item 2, where the source says 'Palambang Province' and the translation silently changes it to "Provinsi Sumatera Selatan" (added fact/correction). Keep the source name or render it neutrally as Palembang.
Item 2: the English has the typo 'B. majusuculus' and the translation silently changes it to "B. majusculus". Acceptable, but the Latin name was altered.
Item 4: "Volumenya sekitar 240 liter" – the English says 243 litres. The number was changed; use about 243 liter (or sensible rounding, but check it is consistent).
Item 11: "batang ekor yang lebih rendah/ramping" – the slash gives two alternatives. Use one term, e.g. "batang ekor yang lebih ramping (kurang tinggi)".
Item 1: "Black lancer" and 'dither' are left as English without italics or an explanation. Consider adding "ikan pengalih (dither)" at first mention.
Item 5: "Spesies ini pemalu dan aktif di malam hari" is OK. "wilayah-wilayah yang terpisah jelas" is slightly stiff; "teritori yang terpisah jelas" is more natural.

bagrichthys-majusculus.name: Black Lancer Catfish
notes: Item 1 and 8: "barbir" for 'barbs' is unusual among hobbyists; use "barb" (italic or plain) instead.

bagrichthys-obscurus.name: Black Lancer obscurus
notes: Item 15: "Keep a single male alongside 3 or more females" is rendered "3 betina atau lebih" - fine, but "seharusnya membantu ... terus-menerus menjadi sasaran" adds "terus-menerus" (continuously), which is not in the source; remove it.

Item 7: "Volume: sekitar 243 liter" - 120×45 cm base with no height given; the figure is carried over from the source. The imperial "48 × 18 in" was correctly dropped, so no change is needed there. Check that the volume is plausible.

Item 1/20: "serrae" translated as "gerigi" and "crenulated" as "bergerigi halus" - the same word is used for two different structures. Use "gerigi/serrasi" for serrae and "berkerut/bergelombang" for crenulated.

Item 20: "genital papilla in males touching the first anal-fin ray" is rendered "menyentuh jari-jari pertama sirip anal" - should be the singular "jari-jari pertama" (the first ray), not plural "jari-jari".
Item 13: "Tubifex" rendered as "cacing sutra" - fine, but "Artemia" is left lowercase; minor.

Item 18: "Not reported in aquaria; there is no breeding report" is rendered as "Belum pernah dilaporkan berkembang biak di akuarium" - slightly changes meaning, since the source says the species is not reported in aquaria at all.
Item 8: "Heater" is left in English; "pemanas" is the more common Indonesian term.
Item 14/15: "Conspecifics may be aggressively territorial" and "sesama jenis" are fine, but "teritorial yang agresif" is awkward.

balitoropsis-zollingeri.name: Balitoropsis zollingeri
notes: Item 5: "Volume: ~54 litres" is kept as ~54 liter. 60×30 cm base with ~54 L is the source's own figure, so leave the number as is, but check that it matches the tank depth.
Item 6: "filter yang kapasitasnya lebih besar dari ukuran akuarium" is a loose rendering of "over-sized filter". Use "filter berkapasitas besar (di atas ukuran standar)".
Item 6: "Anubias sangat berguna" replaces "The latter", which in the English refers to the plants. This is fine, but "Anubias spp." before it is a bit repetitive.

Item 6: "aufwuchs (lapisan alga dan mikroorganisme)" leaves a German term in place. Use the common hobby term "lumut/alga dan biofilm", or explain it consistently. In item 8, "aufwuchs lainnya" is left unexplained.
Item 9: "lele dari genus Glyptothorax, Akysis, dan Oreoglanis spp." mixes "genus" with "spp.". Use "lele Glyptothorax, Akysis, dan Oreoglanis".
Item 9: "teman setangki" is slightly informal. Use "ikan penghuni bersama (tankmate)".
Item 12: "loach 'lizard' (kadal)" and "'black gecko'" are mixed in how they are quoted. Make the trade names consistent, for example 'lizard loach' and 'black gecko loach'.

Item 2: "Tutup yang rapat juga wajib" moves the lid sentence around and duplicates it, which is faithful to the source. "mutlak hidup" for "obligate dweller" is awkward. Use "hanya hidup di" or "penghuni khas".

bangana-behri.name: Incisilabeo
notes: #2 'Ukurannya bisa mencapai 450 hingga 550 mm': keep as is or convert to cm (45–55 cm); mixing mm with cm elsewhere is inconsistent.
#2/#5 'bermigrasi ke hulu Sungai Sekong': 'up the ... rivers' is fine, but 'siprinid' is non-standard; use 'ikan famili Cyprinidae' or 'ikan karper'.
#14 'nama persembahan untuk Otto Behr': awkward; use 'nama untuk menghormati Otto Behr'.
#14 'Bersama Bangana behri, didatangkan juga Labeo pierrei': 'came along with' is vague; the added 'didatangkan' is acceptable but could be clearer as 'ikut masuk dalam kiriman yang sama'.
#1 'Nama umum: Two-headed carp': add an Indonesian gloss or keep as the trade name; the 'tonjolan seperti tanduk' for 'horn' weakens the source.
#15 'Tubuh dan kepalanya juga tampak sangat tinggi': 'deep' means body depth; use 'tubuh dan kepalanya sangat tinggi (pipih tegak)', and the phrase 'tampak' is added.
#15 'mengesahkan kembali Incisilabeo': use 'menghidupkan kembali/memvalidasi kembali' for taxonomic revalidation.

bangana-devdevi.name: Bangana devdevi
notes: "Lokasi tipe" is acceptable, but "lokalitas tipe" is the more standard taxonomic term.
"SL" is left unexplained; consider "panjang standar (SL)" on first use.

barbodes-aurotaeniatus.name: Barbodes aurotaeniatus
notes: Item 10: "dengan enam ekor dari tiap jenis kelamin" – English says "half a dozen specimens of each sex being a good number"; fine, but "betina tampak bertelur (perutnya gendut)" adds a gloss; use "tampak penuh telur (gravid)" without the colloquial addition.
Item 10: "air matang" for "mature water" is misleading in Indonesian (means boiled water); use "air yang sudah matang/berumur (siklus nitrogen sudah berjalan)" or "air akuarium matang".
Item 10: "Taxiphyllum spp." is left unitalicized as in the source; should be italicized as a Latin genus name.

Item 8: "Banyak loach ... Botiidae yang berukuran kecil" – the English says "many cobitid, nemacheilid, and smaller botiid loaches"; "smaller" applies only to botiids, but the translation makes it ambiguous. Rephrase as "loach Cobitidae, Nemacheilidae, dan Botiidae yang lebih kecil" carefully.

Item 8: "minimal 6–10 ekor" – "at least 6-10" is contradictory; "minimal 6 ekor, idealnya hingga 10" is clearer. "hasilnya akan tampak lebih alami" loses "rewarded with a more natural-looking spectacle" (pemandangan lebih alami).
Item 4: Dimension in inches was dropped (acceptable), but volume "72 liter" matches; no issue. Item 5: "Setup" is left as an English term; prefer "tata letak/aquascape".

Item 11: "gurat sisi lengkap atau tidak" and "Sungut rostral ada" are stiff; use "ada sungut rostral". "Aspek ontogeni" is fine, but "Kemungkinan belum pernah tercatat" (item 10) should be "Mungkin belum pernah tercatat (pemijahan)".

barbodes-banksi.name: Barbodes banksi
notes: Item 11: 'broad bar' rendered as 'garis lebar' is ambiguous with 'stripe/garis'. Use 'balok/pita tegak lebar' or 'garis tegak lebar'.
Item 5: 'Tetap saja' for 'though' is slightly off in tone. 'Meski demikian' or 'namun' is more natural.

barbodes-binotatus.name: Wader cakul
notes: Item 1: 'Wader cakul (spotted barb)' – 'wader cakul' is a name for Barbodes binotatus in Indonesia, fine; but the 'ikan cyprinid' phrasing is acceptable. No fix needed here.
Item 4: Volume 'sekitar 243 liter' – 120×45×45 cm is not stated in the source; it is the source's figure and was kept, so OK. However 'minimal 120 × 45 cm' should keep wording 'ukuran alas'; fine.
Item 5: 'sangat disarankan' overstates 'is recommended' – change to 'disarankan'.
Item 5: 'Arus sederas air bah' – 'torrent-like' means a fast mountain stream; use 'arus deras seperti torrent/sungai pegunungan', not 'air bah' (flood).
Item 3: 'kolam-kolam di dasar air terjun' – should be 'kolam di dasar air terjun' (plunge pools); 'dasar' ok. 'AMSL' rendered fine.

Item 10: 'diisi air matang' – 'mature water' means water from a mature aquarium (air dari akuarium matang), not 'air matang' which means boiled water in Indonesian; fix to 'air dari akuarium yang sudah matang'.
Item 10: 'dua pasang... dimasukkan' ok; 'microworm' and 'spawning mop' left in English – add italics or local term 'cacing mikro'.
Item 11: 'pangkal awal sirip punggung' for 'base of the dorsal-fin origin' is clumsy; 'di awal pangkal sirip punggung' would be simpler.
Item 11: 'bintik di tengah sisi tubuh... garis lateral' – 'lateral stripe' rendered 'garis lateral' conflicts with the term 'gurat sisi' used later; use 'garis sisi tubuh'.
Item 7: 'kutu air' for Daphnia is ok; 'pelet butiran kering' is redundant with 'granules'.

barbodes-everetti.name: Clown Barb
notes: Item 2: 'di Kalimantan bagian Indonesia (Borneo Indonesia)' is clumsy and redundant for 'Kalimantan Barat province, Indonesian Borneo'. Suggest 'Provinsi Kalimantan Barat, wilayah Borneo Indonesia'.
Item 2: 'belum ada catatan pasti yang bisa diperoleh' drops the sense of 'we've been unable to obtain'. Rephrase neutrally: 'tidak diperoleh catatan pasti'.
Item 5: 'sungai atau aliran berarus' is awkward and redundant. Use 'sungai berarus'.
Item 5: 'Arus deras seperti torrent' leaves English 'torrent' in place. Use 'arus sangat deras seperti air terjun/jeram'.
Item 5: 'air yang nyaris bersih sempurna' is a bit stiff. Use 'air yang nyaris tanpa polutan'.
Item 10: 'Dalam kedua cara tersebut, indukan kemungkinan akan memakan telur' softens 'will probably eat ... given the chance'. Tighten to 'kemungkinan besar akan memakan telur bila ada kesempatan'.
Item 10: 'satu atau dua pasang kemudian dimasukkan' loses the sense of instruction ('should be introduced'). Use 'sebaiknya dimasukkan'.
Item 11: 'pangkal depan sirip punggung' for 'dorsal-fin origin' is fine, but 'garis tengah perut' is imprecise. Use 'garis tengah ventral'.
Item 8: 'balitorid yang kuat (hillstream loach)' is inconsistent. 'Famili Balitoridae' would be more consistent with the other families.
Item 1: 'jarang ada di hobi akuarium' is awkward. Use 'jarang ditemui dalam hobi akuarium'.

barbodes-kuchingensis.name: False Spanner Barb
notes: Item 4: '120 × 45 cm ... (sekitar 243 liter)' is an unconverted/unchecked figure; the volume is kept from source and is not a sensible rounded value. Verify the number, or round as 'sekitar 240 liter'.
Item 11: 'pangkal depan sirip punggung' for 'dorsal-fin origin' is OK, but 'pita tegak' for 'broad bar' is awkward; use 'pita vertikal/balok lebar'.
Item 11: 'tinjauan parsial' / 'keranjang sampah' in quotes adds a metaphor not in the source ('catch-all'); use 'kelompok serba-ada' or 'kelompok tampung-semua'.
Item 2: 'sistem danau Danau Sentarum' is redundant; use 'sistem danau di Danau Sentarum'.
Item 7: 'kutu air' for Daphnia is acceptable, but 'mencari makan dengan memakan' is wordy; use 'pemakan'.
Item 3: 'batu dan bongkahan batu halus' reads awkwardly; 'smooth' may be misread as modifying only boulders. Rephrase to 'batu dan bongkahan batu yang halus terkikis air'.
Item 1: 'plus garis pendek' is too colloquial for a handbook; use 'serta'.

Item 5: 'Ganti air mingguan ... juga sebaiknya dijadikan rutinitas' loosens the source structure ('plus ... should be considered routine'); fine, but 'tata letak' for 'aquascaping' shifts meaning slightly.

barbodes-lateristriga.name: Spanner barb
notes: Item 3: "Ikan muda dan remaja" for juveniles and subadults is fine, but "sungai-sungai kecil" for "forest streams" is acceptable. The real issue is "batu dan bongkahan batu halus", which reads as if only the boulders are smooth. Rephrase it.
Item 8: "Danio, Devario, dan Barilius yang berukuran lebih besar" is ambiguous. "larger" should apply only to Danio (larger Danio). Fix it so the meaning is clear.
Item 8: "cukup agresif" for "quite boisterous" shifts the meaning toward aggression. Use "cukup heboh/aktif". The same applies in item 1: "Ikan ini cukup agresif dan lincah".
Item 11: "Tweedei (1961)" repeats the English typo. The reference list has "Tweedie", so correct it to "Tweedie".
Item 11: "titik di pangkal depan sirip punggung" for "dorsal-fin origin" is fine. However, "pita tegak yang lebar" for "broad bar" is awkward. Use "balok/pita vertikal".
Item 5: "Ganti air mingguan ... juga sebaiknya dianggap sebagai rutinitas" is acceptable. "sungai berarus" drops the "or river" part of "stream or river". Add "atau sungai besar".

Item 10: "pemijah bebas yang menyebar telur" is okay. "Sebaiknya ... indukan ... dimasukkan" changes "should then be introduced" slightly, but it is acceptable. "burayak" is a non-standard term for fry here; "benih" or "anakan" is more common among hobbyists.

barbodes-semifasciolatus.name: Chinese barb
notes: #12: "Indukan akan dengan mudah memakan telurnya" is stiff. Use "Indukan cenderung memakan telurnya" or "akan langsung memakan telurnya".
#24: "pemijah bebas penyebar telur yang tidak menunjukkan pengasuhan induk" is clumsy. Use "pemijah penyebar telur yang tidak menjaga telur maupun anaknya".
#24: "mikroworm" is half-translated. Use "cacing mikro (microworm)" or "microworm" in italics.
#4: "punggung yang melengkung curam" is a loose rendering of "steeply-sloped back". Use "punggung yang menanjak curam" or "bagian punggung yang miring tajam".

barbonymus-altus.name: Red Tail Tinfoil Barb
notes: Item 4: '(8 in)' and '(60 × 24 in)' and '(~143 US gal)' dropped. Metric conversion is fine, but 'Standard length: 210 mm SL (8 in)' is already metric, so this is acceptable; no real issue except 'SL' left without explanation.

Item 5: 'koloni bakteri yang diinginkan' misattaches 'desired' (levels of oxygen, flow and surface area are what is desired); rephrase to 'tingkat oksigen, arus, dan luas permukaan yang diinginkan untuk koloni bakteri'.
Item 5: 'mudah kaget' for 'skittish' is fine, but 'kadang cukup' is vague; minor.
Item 7: 'zukini yang sudah direbus sebentar' fine; 'kutu air' for Daphnia is acceptable but 'Daphnia' is the usual hobby term, so keep Daphnia/kutu air.
Item 8: 'Hasilnya, tampilan akuarium akan jauh lebih alami, plus perilaku ...' is awkward; 'plus' is colloquial. Rephrase to 'serta perilaku ikan yang menarik'.
Item 8: 'mudah kaget atau bahkan agresif' for 'skittish' acceptable; 'cara makannya yang cukup beringas' is a bit strong for 'rather vigorous feeding behaviour'; use 'cukup agresif/bersemangat'.
Item 10: 'menghasilkan anakan dalam jumlah besar' – 'broods' fine; 'penyebar telur' acceptable but 'egg-scatterer' is usually 'penyebar telur (egg scatterer)'.
Item 11: 'Banyak pemilik toko akan bilang' is colloquial; use 'akan mengatakan'.
Item 11: 'sirip perut' for pelvic fins is fine; no change.
Item 2/3: 'Pada bulan-bulan yang lebih basah ini' is slightly awkward; use 'pada bulan-bulan basah tersebut'.

barbonymus-gonionotus.name: Ikan tawes
notes: #10: "saat sedang bertelur" for "gravid" means laying eggs. Use "saat penuh telur" or "sedang membawa telur".
#3: The type locality "Indonesia: Java: Kalimas River [Brantas] in Surabaya" is left wholly in English. Write "Indonesia: Jawa: Sungai Kalimas [Brantas] di Surabaya".
#9: "ikan lele/catfish" is inaccurate, because lele is only one catfish group. Use "ikan catfish" or "lele dan catfish lain".
#9: "cara makannya yang cukup rakus" slightly overstates "rather vigorous feeding behaviour". "cukup agresif/bersemangat" is closer.

barbonymus-schwanefeldii.name: Tinfoil barb
notes: "mudah panik" for "skittish" is slightly off; "mudah kaget" or "mudah gugup" is more natural (items 2, 6, 9).
"cara makannya yang cukup rakus" adds a negative nuance to "rather vigorous feeding behaviour"; "cukup agresif/lincah saat makan" is closer.
"saat sedang bertelur" for "gravid" is imprecise; use "saat sedang membawa telur / penuh telur".
"affluent river channels" (probably meant as tributaries) is dropped; "sungai berukuran sedang" loses the idea of tributary channels, though this is minor.

barbronia-weberi.name: Lintah Asia
notes: "Alat isap" for suckers: the standard zoological term is "batil isap" (anterior/posterior).
"udang hias kerdil" for dwarf shrimp is stilted. Use "dwarf shrimp" or "udang hias"/"udang kerdil".

barbucca-diabolica.name: Fire Eye Loach
notes: Item 8: 'A group of six or eight specimens should be the smallest considered' is rendered as 'Kelompok berisi enam atau delapan ekor sebaiknya menjadi jumlah paling sedikit' – acceptable, but 'if geography isn't an issue' became 'asal-usul geografis tidak dipermasalahkan', which is vague. Use 'jika perbedaan wilayah asal tidak jadi masalah'.
Item 8: 'Not especially robust' became 'tidak terlalu kuat', which is ambiguous. Use 'kurang tangguh' or 'tidak terlalu tahan banting'.
Item 2: 'bisa ternyata merupakan spesies tersendiri' is awkward word order. Use 'suatu saat ternyata bisa terbukti merupakan spesies tersendiri'.
Item 5: 'aufwuchs' is translated as 'biofilm/perifiton'. Perifiton alone is better, and 'tampil sebaik-baiknya' is stiff. Use 'tampil paling indah'.
Item 5: 'water worn rocks' became 'batu sungai yang membulat'. Use 'batu yang terkikis air' or 'batu kali'.
Item 11: 'sirip ekor berlekuk dangkal (emarginate)' is fine, but 'terekspos' for 'exposed' is awkward. Use 'terbuka' or 'tidak tertutup'.
Item 11: 'mengarah ke atas-samping' is clumsy for 'dorso-laterally orientated'. Use 'menghadap ke atas dan ke samping'.

Item 3: 'Kemungkinan besar ia hanya hidup' ('probably restricted to') is fine, but 'Kawasan ini berupa daerah pegunungan' reads slightly stiff. Use 'Kawasan pegunungan berhutan ini seluas hampir 800 km²'.

belodontichthys-dinema.name: Belodontichthys dinema
notes: Item 7: "Pemakan ikan obligat (piscivora)" is awkward; "ikan karnivora pemakan ikan (piscivora)" is more natural.
Item 11: "Risiko Rendah (Least Concern)" is dated; the current Indonesian IUCN term is "Berisiko Rendah" or "Resiko Rendah". Use "Least Concern" with the standard Indonesian term.
Item 11: "menamainya ulang menjadi" is fine, but "sinonim objektif" is stiff; "sinonim objektif (objective synonym)" would be clearer.
Item 1/4/5: "Butuh" is colloquial for a handbook; use "Memerlukan" or "Membutuhkan".

Item 1: "ikan lele" is acceptable, but this is a Siluriformes catfish, not a true Clarias lele; "lele" alone, or "ikan patin/lais", is closer to what local hobbyists use (lais is the local name for this group).

belontia-hasselti.name: Selincah
notes: Item 10: "sangat subur" for "very fecund" is imprecise. Use something like "menghasilkan banyak telur".
Item 10: "dengan jantan yang menjaga telur" narrows "paternal" to egg guarding. Use "jantan yang mengasuh telur dan anakan" or "pengasuhan oleh jantan".
Item 3: "kerabat murad" for Melaleuca (myrtle) is vague. Consider "Melaleuca (famili Myrtaceae/gelam)".
Item 5: "Buah alder (alder cone)" is awkward. Consider "kerucut alder" or "kerucut pohon alder".

betta-albimarginata.name: Betta albimarginata
notes: Item 17: "more vigorous fishes" is rendered as "lebih agresif". This slightly changes the meaning. "lebih aktif/tangkas" is closer.
Item 10: "mengakses lapisan udara" is stiff. "mengambil napas dari lapisan udara" would read more naturally.

betta-anabatoides.name: Betta anabatoides
notes: Item 6: "bisa mencapai panjang sekitar 12,5 cm" turns "up to 5 inches" into an approximation; "hingga 12,5 cm" or "mencapai 12,5 cm" is closer.
Item 2: "cukup toleran" softens "more tolerant"; "lebih toleran" would be more literal.

betta-antoni.name: Betta antoni
notes: Item 16: 'Meskipun sebagian penangkar tidak pernah mengalami masalah ... penangkar lain pernah kehilangan ..., tetapi banyak yang memindahkan betina' – contrast is garbled; should say many breeders remove the female as a precaution regardless.
Item 16: 'penutup yang serapat mungkin' is fine, but 'dipungut dengan mulut oleh betina' is awkward; use 'diambil dengan mulut betina'.
Item 16: 'pakan hidup yang bergerak seperti microworm dan naupli artemia' – 'motile foods' is better as 'pakan hidup yang aktif bergerak'; minor.
Item 18: 'ada garis dagu' and 'sirip ekor biasanya dengan garis-garis melintang' are stilted; use 'terdapat garis dagu' and 'biasanya bergaris melintang'.
Item 18: 'suprabranchial'/'epibranchial' left in English; give Indonesian forms (suprabrankial, epibrankial).
Item 7: 'pelompat yang sangat andal' – 'andal' is odd for jumping; use 'pelompat ulung'.
Item 13: 'ikan yang ... lebih aktif dan lincah' for 'vigorous' – acceptable but 'intimidate' rendered as 'tertekan' (stressed); use 'mengintimidasi/membuatnya takut'.
Item 11: 'kutu air' for Daphnia is acceptable; 'cacing sutra' for blackworms in item 10 is a different worm (Tubifex); use 'cacing hitam (blackworm)'.
Item 1: 'Pemijahan: pengeram mulut' – 'Breeding' type; fine, but 'Tangkapan alam' should be 'Tangkapan liar'.

betta-bellica.name: Betta bellica
notes: Item 4: "karena air tidak selalu tersedia sepanjang tahun" – English says permanent water is not always available; "sepanjang tahun" is an added meaning. Use "karena genangan air permanen tidak selalu ada".

Item 6: "filter spons bertenaga aerator yang diatur agar sirkulasinya pelan" – fine, but "unit reverse osmosis" is OK. The main issue is "Akuarium harus ditutup rapat"; "mengakses lapisan udara" is stiff. Use "mengambil udara dari lapisan udara lembap".

Item 3: Place-name text left in English (neotype and type locality quotes). Because this is a quoted locality citation it is acceptable, but "provinsi Utara" should be "Sumatra Utara" for Indonesian readers.
Item 3: "43 kilometers" is left as in the original quote; fine, but the quote is an untranslated English sentence that could be given a short Indonesian gloss.
Item 8: "cacing darah beku" is fine, but "blackworm hidup" could be "cacing hitam (blackworm)".

Item 10 and 16: "Betta unimaculata" vs "kompleks Unimaculata" – keep species names consistent. In item 16, "Sirip ... dan ekor jantan lebih runcing" repeats the caudal fin and tail as separate items, which is as in the source.
Item 12: "Jantan berwarna lebih bagus" is informal; "warna jantan lebih menarik/cerah" is more natural.
Item 15: "Proses ini diulang sampai telur betina habis" – the source says the female is spent ("lelah/habis tenaga"). It is not that her eggs run out. Rephrase as "sampai betina kehabisan tenaga".

Item 15: "Betina yang siap kawin warnanya menjadi lebih pucat" is fine. "sperma" for milt should be "air mani/sperma" – OK. "sekadar seleksi alam" is a slight reinterpretation of "survival of the fittest"; keep it close to the source.

betta-breviobesus.name: Betta breviobesus
notes: Item 4: "per 19 liter air" – 5 gallons ≈ 19 L is fine, but "air" was added; use "per 19 liter" (minor).
Item 7: "saling flaring" leaves English; use "saling mengembangkan sirip/insang (flaring)" or "saling menggembungkan insang".
Item 3: "Genangan air tenang" suggests puddles; better "kolam/perairan tenang dan sungai kecil".
Item 1: "Tercatat di IBC" – IBC is not expanded; consider spelling it out (International Betta Congress). "punya" is informal; use "memiliki".

betta-brownorum.name: Betta brownorum
notes: Item 4: 'Many habitats around the former' (= Sibu) is rendered 'di sekitar lokasi yang disebut pertama', which is ambiguous. Name Sibu explicitly: 'di sekitar Sibu'.
Item 8: 'excellent jumper' became 'pelompat yang sangat andal'. This is awkward, since 'andal' means reliable. Use 'pelompat ulung' or 'pandai melompat'.

Item 18: 'Burayak sudah cukup besar untuk langsung menerima pakan hidup... naupli artemia' is faithful. But the final clause 'anakan Betta mengalami masalah kesehatan jika diberi naupli artemia' states a fact; the English says 'reports of'. Add 'dilaporkan' / 'bisa mengalami'.

Item 18: 'the eggs hatch... remaining in the nest for a further 3–4 days... male continues to collect and return any that fall'. The translation changes 'telur' to 'burayak yang jatuh'. Keep 'telur/burayak' consistent with the source (any that fall = larvae/eggs).
Item 18: 'sperma' for milt is acceptable, but 'sel sperma/cairan sperma' is more natural. 'Plastik wrap' for clingfilm is a loanword. Use 'plastik pembungkus makanan'.
Item 19: 'sisik subdorsal', 'lateral' and 'predorsal' follow the source. 'ruas tulang belakang abdominal' is fine. 'tutup insang' for opercle is acceptable. 'sirip perut... falcate' is fine.
Item 1: 'Pemijahan: pembuat sarang busa' is not a natural label. Use 'Tipe pemijahan' or 'Pembuat sarang busa'.

Item 14: 'mengalahkannya dalam berebut makanan' for 'outcompete' is OK. 'Beberapa ikan cyprinid kecil dan loach... cocok dijadikan teman' adds 'teman' (tankmates), which is acceptable. 'Penghuni stenotipik' is jargon but kept from the source.

betta-burdigala.name: Betta burdigala
notes: Item 4: IUCN status 'Vulnerable' ('Rentan') since 1996 conflicts with item 1 'Critically Endangered' ('Kritis'). This is a source inconsistency, so keep each as written, but check the source.
Item 1: 'tangkapan alam' is fine, but 'Betta uberis tetapi tanpa bintik di bagian tengah tubuh' is an acceptable rendering. Not a problem.

Item 6: the original gives '1.2 - 1.5 inches (about 3-3.8 cm)'. Using 'sekitar' is fine. However, '1 pasang per 5 gallons' is rendered as 'per sekitar 19 liter'; 5 US gallons is about 19 L, so this is correct. No change needed.

Item 17: 'Floating plants may be incorporated into the nest' is rendered 'tanaman apung... mungkin dimasukkan ke dalam sarang'. This wrongly suggests the keeper adds them. Say instead that the male may incorporate floating plants into the nest, e.g. 'dapat disertakan jantan dalam sarang'.

Item 17: 'sperma' for 'milt' is acceptable, but 'mengalami masalah kesehatan jika diberi naupli artemia berlebihan' drops 'young Betta... reports exist' nuance. Reword to 'ada laporan bahwa Betta muda mengalami masalah kesehatan bila diberi naupli artemia berlebihan'.
Item 7: the SL conversion '1.4 in' was dropped, which is fine. No issue.

Item 5: 'sepanjang tahun' in the last sentence is slightly added ('karena air tidak selalu tersedia sepanjang tahun'). The original says 'permanent water is not always available', so use 'air permanen tidak selalu tersedia'.
Item 17: 'induk biasanya bisa dibiarkan tetap di akuarium' is OK. 'Dasar perairan' is fine.
Item 18: 'sisik postdorsal', 'predorsal' and 'subdorsal' are left as English terms; use Indonesian-style 'sisik di depan/belakang sirip punggung' if possible.

betta-channoides.name: Betta channoides
notes: Item 19: 'dorsal fin insertion above 10-11th lateral scale row' became 'ke-10-11' / 'ke-4-5' / 'ke-12-13' / 'ke-5-7'; the ordinal range reads ambiguously. Write 'ke-10 sampai 11' or similar.
Item 19: 'predorsal length 65.2-61.7' was copied as in the source, but the range looks reversed. Keep the numbers, but the odd phrasing may need a check.
Item 18: 'Mouthbrooder jantan: jantan yang mengerami...' is clumsy for 'Paternal mouthbrooder'. Use 'Mouthbrooder paternal (jantan yang mengerami telur di mulut)'.
Item 18: 'tata seperti yang dijelaskan di atas' is vague. Say 'tata seperti yang disarankan di atas' and clarify that it refers to the tank set-up.
Item 18: 'microworm' and 'kutu air' for Daphnia are acceptable, but 'The fry are large enough to accept motile foods' was changed to 'pakan hidup'. Use 'pakan yang bergerak'.
Item 21: The reference list is untranslated, which is fine.

Item 9: 'Microsorum, Taxiphyllum or Cryptocoryne spp.' is fine. 'air-powered sponge filter set to turn over gently' was rendered 'Filter spons bertenaga aerator', which is OK. 'Sifat: damai' in item 2 and the 'Pemijahan' label are fine.
Item 14: 'mengintimidasinya dan mengalahkannya saat berebut pakan' is slightly stiff. Use 'mengintimidasi dan kalah bersaing mendapatkan pakan'. 'riset yang matang wajib dilakukan' is also stiff.

betta-chloropharynx.name: Betta chloropharynx
notes: Item 4: "sekitar 72 liter" is wrong for 80 × 30 cm base; the English figure is taken as given, but check it (depth unspecified, so the volume can't be verified). Keep consistent with the source.
Item 5: "kayu apung (driftwood)" is misleading, because driftwood in the hobby is kayu akar/bogwood and does not float. Use "kayu rendam" or "kayu driftwood" instead.
Item 5: "pelompat yang handal" should be "andal" (standard spelling).
Item 8: "Beberapa ikan kecil dari famili Cyprinidae" adds "famili" and drops "cyprinids". Use "sebangsa cyprinid" or "ikan cyprinid kecil".
Item 8: "loach" is left in English. Use "ikan lohok/botia" or "ikan loach" with a gloss.
Item 10: "Telur yang sudah dibuahi ditampung di sirip anal jantan" is acceptable but "cacing mikro" for microworm is ok. "pelukan 'latihan'" for 'dummy' embraces is odd. Use "pelukan semu/palsu".
Item 10: "Termasuk mouthbrooder ... oleh pejantan" is awkward. Use "Mouthbrooder paternal (jantan mengerami telur di mulut)".
Item 1: "Satu populasi ... dulu dianggap satu spesies dengannya" is awkward. Item 10: "dipungut ke mulut betina" is slightly off. Use "diambil dengan mulut betina".
Item 3: "Kandungan mineral terlarutnya umumnya nyaris nol" turns "negligible" into "nearly zero". This is acceptable but a bit stronger than the source. Use "sangat rendah/dapat diabaikan".

betta-coccina.name: Cupang Coccina
notes: Item 3: "Kanopi ranting yang rapat" – canopy of branches; ok, but "karena air tidak selalu tersedia sepanjang tahun" changes "permanent water is not always available" (air permanen) – should be "air yang menetap/permanen tidak selalu tersedia".
Item 10: "Jika ada tanaman apung, tanaman itu mungkin ikut dijadikan bagian sarang" is okay, but "mengembalikan larva yang jatuh" – English says eggs ("any that fall"); use "telur" not "larva".
Item 10: "kuning telurnya terserap habis" – yolk sac should be "kantung kuning telur".
Item 10: "sperma" for milt – better "cairan sperma (milt)"; "sampai telur betina habis" fine.
Item 10: "pakan hidup yang bergerak" for motile foods fine; "Wadah film kamera bekas" okay but add 'rol film'.
Item 5: "Tanaman apung juga disukai" fine; "filter spons bertenaga aerator ... diatur agar sirkulasinya lembut" ok; "jago melompat" is colloquial – use "pelompat yang handal".
Item 7: "kutu air" for Daphnia is acceptable but "Daphnia" is commonly used; "chironomid" okay.
Item 1: the lead sentence "Nama spesies ini dipakai untuk kelompok" ok; "pembuat sarang busa" fine.
Item 4: the volume ~41 L is fine; no issue.
Item 8: "riset yang matang" – better "pencarian informasi yang cermat".

betta-cracens.name: Betta cracens
notes: Item 5: "kayu beech atau oak" is left in English. Use "kayu beech/oak (ek)" or briefly explain the wood types, since Indonesian hobbyists may not know them.
Item 5: "ikan ini juga jago melompat" is too colloquial for a handbook. Use "pelompat yang handal" or "sangat mudah melompat".
Item 5: "peternak" is used for breeders throughout. "Penangkar" or "pembiak" is more usual in the hobby.
Item 8: "cyprinid kecil dan loach" are left as English terms. Use "ikan sekerabat cyprinid kecil dan ikan loach (botia)", or explain them.
Item 10: "Pengeram mulut oleh induk jantan" is awkward. "Pengeram mulut paternal (dierami oleh jantan)" would be clearer.
Item 10: "pelukan kosong" for 'dummy' embraces is a slightly loose rendering. "Pelukan semu" or "pelukan tanpa pelepasan telur" is better.
Item 10: "burayak sudah cukup besar untuk langsung menerima pakan hidup". "Burayak" is a regional term for fry, and "anakan" is used for the same fish elsewhere in the text. Keep the term consistent.
Item 11: "sepasang organ suprabranchial" and "epibranchial" are left as English anatomical terms. Use Indonesian forms (suprabrankial/epibrankial) or add an explanation.

betta-dennisyongi.name: Betta dennisyongi
notes: Item 4: "Kota Singkil" renders "town" as a city; "Kota Meulaboh" and "Kota Singkil" could be written as "kota kecil Singkil" or just "Singkil" (minor).

betta-dimidiata.name: Betta dimidiata
notes: Item 8: "sekitar 41 liter" is fine, but item 20: "jantan mengerami... sebelum disemburkan ke air untuk ditangkap jantan" is OK; real issue below.

Item 20: "burayak Betta mengalami masalah kesehatan jika terlalu banyak diberi artemia" turns "reports of" into a flat statement; keep it hedged, e.g. "ada laporan bahwa burayak Betta bisa mengalami masalah kesehatan bila terlalu banyak diberi artemia".
Item 20: "kecuali ikan sudah dipelihara tanpa ikan lain" is awkward and unclear; use "kecuali ikan memang sudah dipelihara sendiri (tanpa spesies lain)".

Item 20: "Telur yang sudah dibuahi ditampung di sirip anal jantan, lalu dipungut ke mulut betina" is correct, but "Setelah semua telur berada di mulut jantan... sampai telur betina habis" is fine; "burayak... sudah terbentuk sempurna" is OK. Item 9: "mengakses lapisan udara" reads stiffly; use "sesekali perlu mengambil udara dari lapisan udara lembap".
Item 7: "karena air tidak selalu tersedia sepanjang tahun" adds "sepanjang tahun"; the English says permanent water is not always available ("air permanen tidak selalu tersedia").
Item 2/22: the claim "mudah dibedakan" is fine, but item 2 "sirip ekornya bisa membedakan keduanya" is awkward; use "sirip ekornya yang membedakan keduanya".
Item 5: "danau-danau Danau Sentarum" is redundant; use "kawasan Danau Sentarum".
Item 12: "Aliran air yang lembut atau nyaris tanpa arus lebih disukai" is clumsy; use "Lebih disukai aliran air yang pelan atau nyaris tanpa arus".
Item 19: "Burayak yang baru dilepaskan bisa langsung makan" is fine, but "pelukan percumbuan" is unnatural; use "pelukan saat berpacaran".
Item 10: "Air blackwater yang lunak dan asam adalah yang ideal" is stiff; use "Idealnya air blackwater yang lunak dan asam".

betta-edithae.name: Betta edithae
notes: Item 1: 'Ukuran maksimal: sekitar 5,8 cm' is fine, but the 'much better coloration ... above 78°F (about 26°C)' line is rendered 'di atas sekitar 26 °C'. This is acceptable, so no change is needed here. The real problem is item 2/19: the sentence 'membran branchiostegal dan bagian belakang operkulum ... yang buram atau tembus cahaya' is fine.

Item 5: 'sekitar Palembang di Provinsi Sumatera Selatan, Sumatra' changes the source's 'near Palembang'. It also reads as if the province is 'Sumatra'. Rephrase to: 'di dekat Palembang (Provinsi Sumatera Selatan, Pulau Sumatra)'.

Item 7: the '60 mm SL (2.4 in SL)' conversion was dropped, which is fine. However '80 × 30 cm ... sekitar 72 liter' keeps the source's volume without the tank height, so it is not verifiable. Check it against the source.

Item 8: 'Buah alder (Alnus)' should be 'kerucut/buah alder (Alnus)'. 'Alder cones' are strobili, not fruit. Also 'ikan ini juga pelompat yang ulung' is slightly awkward. Better: 'dan pandai melompat'.
Item 8: 'filter spons bertenaga aerator' is fine. 'Mikroba ini bisa menjadi sumber pakan' changes the referent: the source says 'These' (the microbe colonies), which is acceptable.
Item 12: 'kutu air' for Daphnia is acceptable. 'Isi perut serangga tersebut dulu' is ambiguous. Rephrase to 'beri makan serangga itu dulu dengan serpihan ikan atau sayuran sebelum diberikan ke ikan'.
Item 13: 'sangat damai' is ok, but the duplicated sentence mirrors the source. No change is needed.

Item 18: 'Telur yang sudah dibuahi ditangkap di sirip anal jantan, lalu dipungut ke mulut betina' is faithful. 'Burayak ... microworm dan naupli artemia' is also fine. But 'anakan Betta ... jika diberi naupli artemia' reads as if the problem was with artemia only, which is correct. Also 'peternak' for 'breeders' is fine. 'plastik wrap' is acceptable.
Item 4: 'kompleks Betta edithae' is acceptable, but the source's 'group' is used inconsistently. Use 'kelompok Betta edithae' to match items 2 and 19.
Item 20: the references are untranslated, as instructed.

betta-enisae.name: Betta enisae
notes: Item 1: 'mengerami telur di mulut (mouthbrooder) oleh pejantan' is awkward. Better 'Betta enisae adalah ikan labirin mouthbrooder yang pengeraman telurnya dilakukan oleh pejantan'.
Item 1: 'Ciri khasnya adalah garis-garis melintang' implies this is the species' only distinguishing feature, which overstates the source. It is a distinguishing character in the complex.
Item 1: 'Indonesian Borneo' became only 'Indonesia', so 'Borneo' is dropped in the summary.
Item 2: 'Lokasi tipenya' is a calque. Use 'Lokalitas tipe' or 'Lokasi penemuan spesimen tipe'.
Item 2: 'terlihat memiliki perbedaan' for 'have been observed to exhibit' is fine. 'ukuran serta proporsi tubuh' for 'morphometrics' is acceptable but loose.
Item 5: 'peternak' for 'breeders' is acceptable, but hobbyists usually say 'breeder' or 'penangkar'.
Item 5: 'Kalau tidak menemukan driftwood' is too casual for a handbook.
Item 5: 'jago melompat' is too colloquial. Use 'pelompat yang andal'.
Item 5: 'filter spons bertenaga aerator' is fine. 'Betta spp.' and 'Cryptocoryne spp.' are left in Latin, which is acceptable.
Item 10: 'Pejantan mengerami telur di mulut.' is fine. 'masa pendekatan' for 'courtship' is vague. Use 'masa pacaran' or 'penjajakan'.

betta-falx.name: Betta falx
notes: Item 2: "more northerly region of Utara" was rendered as "Sumatera Utara". It's a reasonable reading, but the source only says "Utara". Check that this addition is intended.
Item 3: "Dasarnya terutama terdiri dari daun gugur..." is fine. "terukur hanya sedalam" is slightly stiff; "tercatat hanya sedalam" would read better.
Item 5: "jago melompat" is too colloquial for a handbook. Use "pelompat yang andal" or "sangat mudah melompat".
Item 5: "peternak" for "breeders" is acceptable, but "pembiak" or "penangkar" is more common in the hobby.
Item 5: "beech" and "oak" are left in English with no explanation. Add "(beech)" or a local equivalent, or briefly gloss them.
Item 5: "Filter spons bertenaga aerator yang disetel agar sirkulasinya pelan" is fine. "Cryptocoryne spp. dalam pot" is also fine.
Item 8: "cyprinid" and "loach" are left untranslated. Use "ikan cyprinid kecil" and "ikan loach (ikan pasir/ikan keli-kelian)", or at least "ikan loach".
Item 8: "agresif" for "vigorous" changes the meaning. Use "lebih aktif/lincah" instead.
Item 10: "Idealnya, siapkan akuarium terpisah ... kecuali ikan-ikan ini memang sudah dipelihara sendiri" is OK. "masa pendekatan" is acceptable for courtship.
Item 10: "mengerami ... burayak" is acceptable, but "anakan" and "burayak" are mixed. The meaning is intact.

betta-hendra.name: Betta hendra
notes: Item 20: 'Pasangan tidak perlu dipisahkan sebelum memijah' is fine, but 'Floating plants may be incorporated into the nest' became 'Tanaman apung mungkin dimasukkan ke dalam sarang' – it is the male who incorporates them, so say 'Jantan dapat menyertakan tanaman apung ke dalam sarang'.

Item 20: 'Offer small amounts of different foods' is rendered 'sedikit pakan yang beragam', which is fine. But 'fry are large enough to accept motile foods ... immediately' is rendered OK; 'adults do not usually eat their offspring' is OK. 'Setelah memijah, induk biasanya bisa dibiarkan di tempat' is vague; clarify 'tetap di akuarium pemijahan'.

Item 22: 'The former ... name' / 'the latter' were mistranslated as 'Nama pertama' and 'nama kedua'. The 'latter' refers to B. sp. 'Palangka', but the Indonesian 'Ejaan nama kedua' is ambiguous; say 'Ejaan nama Palangka kemudian dikoreksi'.

Item 22: 'Anggota kelompok B. coccina ... (up to 40 mm, 1.6 in SL)' – 'SL' is left unexplained, so add 'panjang standar (SL)'. 'penghuni stenotipik rawa gambut hutan' reads awkwardly; use 'penghuni khas rawa gambut hutan'.
Item 22: 'kelompok dugaan' for 'putative groups' is unnatural; use 'kelompok yang diduga/diusulkan'.
Item 7: 'kerabat satu genusnya' is awkward for 'congener'; use 'sesama genus Betta'. 'nyaris nol' for 'negligible' mineral content is acceptable but slightly overstated.
Item 19: 'Percumbuan' and 'baby artemia' are slightly unnatural; use 'pacaran/ritual pemijahan' and 'naupli artemia'.
Item 23: References are left in English, as instructed, so there is no issue.
Item 9: 'pelompat yang andal' is an odd way to say 'excellent jumper'; use 'pelompat ulung'. The 'Seperti semua Betta spp.' phrasing is fine.

betta-hipposideros.name: Betta hipposideros
notes: Item 11: "kalah bersaing berebut makanan" adds "berebut makanan". The English only says "outcompete". Use "kalah bersaing".
Item 14: "Pengeram mulut oleh jantan" is a bit stiff. "Jantan mengeram telur di mulut" would read more naturally.

betta-ideii.name: Betta ideii
notes: Item 2: "memicu munculnya warna dan perilaku memijah" is slightly awkward; consider "memicu warna yang lebih cerah dan perilaku berbiak".

betta-imbellis.name: Cupang imbellis
notes: Item 1: 'Maximum size: 2.3 inches (about 6 cm)' is fine, but 'Least Concern (risiko rendah)' is OK; no issue. Real issue is item 19: 'sperma' for milt is acceptable, but 'sampai telur betina habis' is a loose paraphrase of 'until the female is spent'; use 'sampai betina selesai mengeluarkan seluruh telurnya'.

Item 19: 'sementara jantan terus memungut dan mengembalikan burayak yang jatuh' - the English says the male collects eggs that fall ('any that fall'), and the eggs are hatching, so 'burayak' is acceptable; but 'Telur menetas ... lalu tetap berada di sarang' means the hatched fry stay, so 'telur' is wrongly the subject. Rewrite as 'Telur menetas dalam 24–48 jam, dan burayak tetap berada di sarang 3–4 hari berikutnya'.
Item 8: the English gives 'about 41 litres' for a 45 × 30 cm base and the translation keeps it. Check that the figure is right, since the tank height is not stated.
Item 9: 'tropical lilies' is rendered 'teratai tropis'. This is fine. 'Cryptocoryne spp. juga pilihan yang baik' is missing the verb 'merupakan'. Rephrase as 'juga merupakan pilihan yang baik'.
Item 14: 'non-male betta mates' is rendered 'pasangan cupang yang bukan jantan'. 'Mates' means tankmates here, so use 'teman satu akuarium', not 'pasangan', which suggests breeding partners.
Item 20: 'Anabantoidei' is called a 'subordo'. The English also says suborder, so this matches. 'suprabranchial' and 'epibranchial' are left unchanged, which is acceptable.
Item 13: 'chironomid larvae (bloodworm)' is rendered 'larva chironomid (cacing darah)'. Use the common 'jentik/cacing darah (larva Chironomus)'. This is minor.

betta-krataios.name: Betta krataios
notes: Item 10: "ada laporan bahwa anakan Betta mengalami masalah kesehatan" loses 'young Betta developing health issues'; fine, but 'Pejantan ... sirip anal' ok. Real issue: "Telur yang sudah dibuahi ditampung di sirip anal pejantan" is fine.

Item 5: "Penambahan daun kering ... selain memberi tempat berlindung tambahan bagi ikan, juga mendorong" – sentence is clumsy; restructure ("selain menyediakan tempat berlindung tambahan, daun juga mendorong...").
Item 5: "filter spons bertenaga aerator yang diatur agar sirkulasinya pelan" okay, but 'air-powered' better as "filter spons berpenggerak udara".
Item 5: "sangat pandai melompat" is slightly odd; use "pelompat yang andal/sering melompat".
Item 5: "akses lapisan udara lembap" – 'mengakses' is stiff; use "mengambil udara dari lapisan udara lembap".
Item 11: "suprabranchial" and "epibranchial" left in English/Latin form; use "suprabrankial"/"epibrankial" or Indonesian anatomical terms.
Item 11: "organ suprabranchial ... lipatan kulit" – 'paired' → 'sepasang' is fine, but 'menghirup udara bebas' should be "udara atmosfer/udara langsung dari permukaan".
Item 8: "mengalahkannya dalam berebut makanan" adds 'for food' not in the source (outcompete); use "kalah bersaing".
Item 8: "cocok dijadikan teman" is awkward; use "cocok sebagai teman sekolam".
Item 8: "dalam kelompok akan menunjukkan" – 'cyprinid dan loach' left in English; use "ikan cyprinid (sejenis ikan mas) dan ikan loach/pasir" or add local terms.

betta-lehi.name: Betta lehi
notes: Item 8: "mengalahkannya dalam berebut makanan" adds "makanan" (food). The English only says "outcompete". Use "mengungguli/mengalahkannya dalam persaingan".
Item 11: "suprabranchial" and "epibranchial" are left as English/Latin anatomical terms. Optionally use Indonesian forms such as "suprabrankial" and "epibrankial".

betta-livida.name: Betta livida
notes: Item 1: 'Ikan ini anggota berwarna merah dari kelompok B. coccina' is missing the verb 'adalah' and reads awkwardly. Also 'status terancam punah (endangered)' is fine, but 'sarang busa' for a labyrinth fish is OK.
Item 8: 'ikan ini juga pelompat yang sangat andal' – 'andal' (reliable) is the wrong nuance for 'excellent jumper'. Use 'pelompat ulung' or 'sangat pandai melompat'.

Item 8: 'Tanaman air ... bisa ditambahkan' drops the 'You could add' framing, which is minor. 'filter spons bertenaga aerator yang diatur agar airnya berputar pelan' is clumsy; use 'filter spons dengan aerator yang diatur pelan'.

Item 16: 'Jika ada tanaman apung, tanaman itu mungkin ikut dijadikan bagian dari sarang' is OK, but 'Gunakan tutup akuarium yang serapat mungkin' is fine. 'larva tetap berada di sarang' adds the word 'larva' where the English says 'eggs remaining in the nest' (the eggs hatch, so the meaning is not clearly the same). Say 'telur/larva'.
Item 16: 'sperma dan beberapa butir telur dikeluarkan' – 'milt' is better as 'cairan sperma/air mani jantan'. Also 'ikan dewasa ... tidak memakan anaknya' is fine.

Item 18: 'jari-jari sirip anal', 'sisik subdorsal' are fine, but 'hanya hidup di rawa gambut hutan' for 'stenotypic' loses the meaning that it is restricted to this habitat. 'Sirip perut' for pelvic fin is fine.
Item 2: 'Betta' is rendered 'cupang' here but kept as 'Betta' elsewhere. Keep the term consistent across entries.
Item 11: 'kutu air' for Daphnia is acceptable, but 'kutu air' may be confused with other things. Consider 'Daphnia (kutu air)'.

betta-mahachaiensis.name: Betta Mahachai
notes: Item 14: "mengalahkannya dalam berebut makanan" adds "makanan" (food), which the English "outcompete it" doesn't say. Use a more neutral wording such as "menyisihkannya dalam persaingan".
Item 18: "larva tetap di sarang" is fine, but "anakan Betta" and "burayak" are used interchangeably for fry. Use one term consistently.

betta-mandor.name: Betta mandor
