notes: Item 4: in "P 120 cm × T 45 cm × L 37,5 cm", "L" for lebar is easy to confuse with L for litre. Consider writing "Lebar" in full or using "P × L × T" with the words spelled out.
Item 10: "telur/larva" adds a word that is not in the source (it says only "they"). Use "telur" alone.

heros-severus.name: Severum
notes: "agak sadah" for "medium hard": use "sadah sedang" (or "kesadahan sedang"); "agak sadah" slightly shifts the meaning.
"Hal ini terutama karena perilaku berkembang biaknya": "berkembang biak" is awkward. Use "perilaku pemijahannya" or "cara berbiaknya".
"mengerami telur di mulut (mouthbreeding)": hobbyists usually say "mouthbrooder" or "pengeram mulut". Also, "bertelur di substrat" is vague; "memijah di substrat (substrate breeder)" is better.
"Amazon, Orinoco": add "Sungai" or "DAS" (e.g., "Sungai Amazon, Sungai Orinoco") so the reader knows these are river systems.
"warnanya mungkin jadi memudar": "jadi" is colloquial; use "menjadi" in the formal handbook register.
"Ikan juga bisa lebih rentan" and "tanda-tanda kondisi yang menurun": stiff and vague. Use "tanda-tanda penurunan kondisi" or "kesehatannya menurun".
"Pakan nabati perlu ditambahkan": the source says "vegetarian components". "Komponen nabati" or "pakan berbahan nabati" is closer. "pelet stik" for "sticks" is fine, but "stik" alone is enough.

homaloptera-parclitella.name: Lizard Loach
notes: Item 3: 'Jadi spesies yang layak dipelihara' for 'recommendable species' is awkward; also the 'we were able' import claim is rendered passively, which is acceptable, but 'Loach cantik ini mutlak' is fine. Main issue is only minor wording.
Item 12: 'pertarungan pamer' for 'comment fights' (Komment fights, ritualised display fights) is unnatural; use 'perkelahian ritual/adu pamer' with a clearer explanation.
Item 9: 'batu dan kerikil sungai yang halus terkikis air' is awkward; use 'batu dan kerikil sungai yang halus terkikis air' → 'batu dan kerikil bulat berbagai ukuran yang terkikis arus'.
Item 9: 'aufwuchs (lapisan alga dan mikroorganisme)' is a German term left in place in items 9 and 11; use 'aufwuchs' with a gloss consistently, or 'lapisan alga/biofilm'.
Item 9: 'Turnover ... 10–15 times' conflicts with item 2 (8–12) in the source itself; this is not a translation error, but 'jadi bila perlu' adds a slightly different logic to 'so ... as necessary'.
Item 16: the translation is missing entirely (left out). The stock code and wholesale note were dropped; if the shop talk is intentionally dropped this is fine, but confirm it.
Item 13: 'lele Glyptothorax, Akysis, dan Oreoglanis spp.' calls the catfishes 'lele', which usually means Clarias; use 'ikan lele-lelean' or 'catfish'.
Item 11: 'kutu air' for Daphnia is acceptable, but 'merumput biofilm' is awkward; use 'memakan biofilm dengan cara merumput'.

hyphessobrycon-amandae.name: Ember Tetra
notes: Item 13: 'very boisterous' is translated as 'sangat agresif'. This changes the meaning; use 'sangat lincah/heboh'.
Item 13: 'tidak akan mampu bersaing' turns 'will not compete well' into an absolute. Use 'kurang mampu bersaing'.
Item 5: 'perairan tenang di tepi sungai (backwater)' is wordy. 'Danau tapal kuda' is acceptable for oxbow, but 'danau oxbow' is also common.
Item 3: 'tidak terganggu' is weaker than 'not affected'. 'Most available' is also unclear. Use 'tidak terdampak'.
Item 7: 'ikan mas koki' is fine, but 'Mungkin tidak perlu sesering membersihkan akuarium ikan mas koki' is awkward. Rephrase it.
Item 12: 'Soal teman satu akuarium' is colloquial. 'Tankmate' is usually written 'tank mate' or 'penghuni akuarium lain'. Also 'bergerombol' vs 'berkelompok' is inconsistent.
Item 17: 'pemijah bebas yang menebar telur' is clumsy. 'Egg-scattering free spawner' is better as 'penebar telur'.
Item 1: the minimum tank size 'sekitar 38 liter' converts 10 gallons correctly, but the item 6 volume is a separate figure. Check that the two sizes are consistent.
Item 10: 'Anda' is used here but not elsewhere, and the register is inconsistent. 'Ikan muda dan indukan' is fine.

hyphessobrycon-eques.name: Serpae Tetra
notes: Item 11: "Disarankan kelompok 12–15 ekor ... tanpa spesies lain penghuni lapisan air atas" is fine, but "mungkin merupakan pilihan terbaik, tetapi pilihan lain yang mungkin termasuk" is clumsy and repeats "mungkin". Rephrase, e.g. "barangkali pilihan terbaik, sedangkan opsi lain meliputi...".
Item 11: "Kelompok minimal 12 ekor sebaiknya dianggap sebagai syarat minimum" is redundant. Use "Kelompok minimal 12 ekor dianggap sebagai syarat minimum".
Item 11: "ikan rainbow" should be "ikan pelangi (rainbowfish)", the usual hobby term.
Item 11: "ikan beranak (livebearer)" is acceptable, but "lele callichthyid atau loricariid" should be clearer, e.g. "lele/ikan sapu-sapu" for loricariid.
Item 14: "Bagaimanapun, ikan ini memang indah" renders "after all" poorly. "Bagaimanapun" means "anyway/however". Use "Lagi pula, ikan ini memang indah".
Item 14: "warna merah bening seperti kristal" and "merah tembus pandang" are fine, but "Brillant" is kept with the German spelling. This is a trade name, so it is fine.
Item 10: "saling merusak sirip" loses the sense of ruffling/nipping. Use "saling menggigiti sirip".
Item 13: "filter spons bertenaga aerator" should be "filter spons berpenggerak udara". "pengasuhan induk" should be "tidak menjaga anakan".
Item 2: "Varian hias hasil penangkaran" says "captive-bred", but the source says "ornamental strains". Use "galur hias" to match item 15.
Item 7: "Pilihan dekorasi tidak terlalu krusial, meskipun warnanya cenderung..." leaves the subject unclear (the fish). Say "ikan ini cenderung menampilkan warna lebih bagus".

hyphessobrycon-herbertaxelrodi.name: Black Neon Tetra
notes: Item 5: "ditanami tanaman air dengan rimbun" is awkward and redundant. Use "ditanami rimbun" or "penuh tanaman air".
Item 8: "direncanakan dengan baik" is a loose rendering of "well-researched". Something like "yang dirancang dengan matang" is more precise.
Item 11: "garis tengah lateral" is a stiff rendering of "midlateral stripe". Use "garis tengah badan" or "garis lateral tengah".

hyphessobrycon-megalopterus.name: Black phantom tetra
notes: Item 3: "kutu air (Daphnia, Moina)" is wrong in meaning for a hobby handbook; Daphnia is usually "kutu air" but Moina is "kutu air" too, so this is acceptable. Better to keep Daphnia and Moina as in the source without the generic gloss.
Item 1/11: "Sebagian besar catatannya" and "dibudidayakan" are fine. Better to use "tulang postorbital" and "bintik humeral" with the usual "bintik bahu" gloss for readability.

Item 2: "anak sungai utama rio Mamoré" for "main affluent" is fine. "yang mengalirkan air dari lahan basah" reverses the sense: the Guaporé drains the Pantanal wetland, so "yang menguras/mengalirkan air lahan basah tropis" would be clearer.

Item 8: "well-researched community aquarium" became "penghuninya sudah dipilih dengan cermat". This slightly changes the meaning. A closer rendering is "akuarium komunitas yang direncanakan dengan matang".
Item 10: "Karena itu, perilakunya lebih menarik dan warnanya lebih bagus" is fine. "Alas plastik model 'rumput'" is a bit vague, so write "matras plastik tipe 'rumput'".

hyphessobrycon-pulchripinnis.name: Lemon Tetra
notes: Item 8: 'each fish soon occupies a tiny territory' is rendered correctly, but 'Memelihara semua jenis lemon tetra' is fine. No change needed here; ignore.
Item 4: 'rio Tapajós basins' / 'municipalities' rendered as 'munisipalitas' – use 'kota/kabupaten (munisipalitas)' for natural Indonesian.
Item 17: 'crystal red' translated as 'merah jernih berkilau' – adds 'berkilau'; use 'merah jernih'.
Item 17: 'Pada Muzel tetra kuning, bercak humeral (di belakang tutup insang)' adds a fact not in the source ('di belakang tutup insang'); remove or keep only 'bercak humeral'.
Item 14: 'well-researched community aquarium' is translated as 'penghuninya dipilih berdasarkan riset yang matang'; simplify to 'akuarium komunitas yang direncanakan dengan baik'.
Item 18: 'Zarske, 2008)[12]' kept; fine. But 'Weitzman & Palmer ... kemonofiletikannya' is awkward; use 'kemonofiletikan kelompok ini'.
Item 3: 'Jacare Acanga' versus 'Jacareacanga' in item 4 – spelling inconsistency between items (source also differs, but harmonise).

hyphessobrycon-rosaceus.name: Rosy Tetra
notes: "tampangnya sangat mirip": too colloquial for a handbook; use "penampilannya sangat mirip".
"tetra ini tetap berenang di akuarium": too literal; use "masih dipelihara di akuarium".
"dibiakkan oleh beberapa peternak": use "penangkar/pembiak" (hobbyist breeders), not "peternak" (livestock farmers).
"Ini bagus, karena dari Guyana... tidak ada impor atau hanya sangat sesekali": awkward and unclear; rephrase, e.g. "impor hanya terjadi sangat jarang atau tidak ada sama sekali".
"tetra phantom": better to follow the Indonesian hobby term order, e.g. "phantom tetra" like "rosy tetra"; the text is inconsistent.
"sailed under this name" → "Nama itu dipakai": the idiom is lost; this is acceptable but rather flat.

hyphessobrycon-sweglesi.name: Red Phantom Tetra
notes: Item 4: 'Kedua tipe biotop yang disebut terakhir' follows the English 'latter two', but the Indonesian sentence in the previous paragraph names river channel, lagoons and floodplain lakes, so the reference is ambiguous. Say 'laguna dan danau dataran banjir' explicitly.
Item 4: the English says morichals 'tend to contain transparent, clear water'. The translation 'umumnya berair jernih' drops 'transparent'. Minor.
Item 4: 'danau tapal kuda (oxbow)' is fine, but 'sering dikaitkan dengan habitat' reads stiffly. Use 'sering ditemukan di habitat'.
Item 12: 'Pigmen merah cerahnya tetap bertahan ... bukan hasil pengaruh pakan' is awkward. Use 'bukan akibat pakan'.
Item 12: 'salah satunya sangat berwarna' is unnatural for 'particularly colourful'. Use 'sangat mencolok warnanya'.
Item 12: 'kelompok dugaan ini' for 'putative assemblage' is hard to read. Use 'kelompok yang diduga ini'.
Item 12: 'garis keturunan polifiletik' and 'didirikan ... sebagai subgenus' are stiff but acceptable. Consider 'dibentuk'.

Item 12: 'jari-jari bercabang pada sirip dubur' and 'gigi premaksila' are fine. However, 'an irregular row of 9-10 premaxillary teeth' is rendered 'satu baris tidak teratur', adding 'satu' (one) where the English has 'an'. Acceptable but check.

Item 9: 'well-researched community aquarium' is rendered 'dirancang dengan cermat'. This changes the meaning slightly, from researched to carefully designed. Use 'direncanakan dengan matang' or 'dipelajari dengan baik'.
Item 11: 'Pemijah bebas yang menyebar telur dan tidak menunjukkan pengasuhan induk' is stiff. Use 'tidak merawat telur/anak'.

inpaichthys-kerri.name: Blue Emperor Tetra
notes: Item 10: "pada sore atau malam hari" adds "sore atau"; the source says only "in the evening", so use "pada malam hari" or "pada sore hari".
Item 8: "kalah bersaing dengan teman setangki yang lebih agresif" drops the idea of "will not compete well" (as a caution). Consider "tidak mampu bersaing dengan ... yang lebih agresif".

iriatherina-werneri.name: Threadfin Rainbow
notes: Item 20: "harlequin rasboras (cá tam giác)" – the Vietnamese phrase was dropped; this is fine, but "angelfish" became "manfish" – use "angelfish/ikan manfish" consistently; "monos and scats" became "monos dan scat (ikan kiper)" – 'ikan kiper' is not scat; remove/fix.

Item 20: "Siamese algae eater", "paradise fish", "Panda garra", "clown killifish" left in English – give common Indonesian names/transliterations or put the English in brackets (e.g. "ikan paradise (Macropodus)").
Item 20: "Walaupun senang berkelompok ... Pelihara minimal 6 ekor (batas paling minimal)" is redundant; "agresif/heboh" for "boisterous" is loose – use "ribut/lincah".

Item 20: "Setelah persaingan selesai" ok; but "cupang menyukai suasana tenang ... threadfin rainbow senang bergerak" fine. "Jauhkan dari semua jenis lobster air tawar" – crayfish = udang karang/lobster air tawar OK.
Item 20: "Anakan udang berumur 1–2 minggu sudah terlalu besar untuk dimakan" fine; "udang kerdil" better "udang hias/dwarf shrimp".
Item 23: "Air yang sudah lama tidak diganti" for "Aged water" – ok; "filter spons bertenaga aerator" – better "filter busa (sponge filter) dengan aerator".
Item 10: "akuarium yang siklus nitrogennya belum matang" – better "akuarium yang belum matang secara biologis/belum cycling"; "ikan ini pilihan yang sangat bagus" fine.
Item 15: "zooplankton lainnya" fine. Item 17: "sebagian diatom" mistranslates "some diatoms" ok; "artemia" for "brine shrimp" ok.
Item 5: "Sungai Merauke" – 'between the Merauke and the Fly Rivers' ok. Item 6: dropped "72–90 °F" fine.

Item 22: "sirip punggung dan sirip anal yang jauh lebih besar" fine; Item 26: "Jari-jari paling dalam sirip perut terhubung ... oleh selaput" awkward; "Pola warnanya terdiri dari ... (opak...)" 'opaque' pigment should be 'putih buram'.

kryptopterus-cryptopterus.name: Ikan lais
notes: Item 20: 'extending beyond tip of pectoral-fin' is rendered 'melewati ujung sirip dada' but the English comparison is 'short barbels (to pectoral base) vs. beyond tip'; this is fine. The real error is item 7: 'biologically immature aquarium' is rendered 'siklus nitrogennya belum matang', which adds a specific claim; use 'akuarium yang belum matang secara biologis'.
Item 1: 'Risiko Rendah (Least Concern)' is acceptable, but 'Size: 200 mm (7.9 in) SL' dropped the inches, which is fine. No error here.
Item 2/20: 'silurid catfish' is rendered 'lais dari famili Siluridae'. This is fine, but in item 13 'lele/catfish Asia' is wrong: Mystus is not a lele (Clarias), so use 'catfish Asia' or 'baung'.
Item 6: the volume '~243 litres' is the English figure left unchanged, so it is fine. The base size needs no change.

Item 12: 'Tubifex' is rendered 'cacing sutra'. Tubifex is commonly called 'cacing sutra' in Indonesia, so this is fine. Item 12 also says 'dan mungkin sesekali cacing tanah kecil', which is acceptable.
Item 14: 'cyprinid' and 'loach' are left in English; use 'ikan cyprinid (suku karper)' and 'ikan loach (botia)' for readability.

Item 3: 'DAS Mekong dan Chao Phraya' is fine, but the English is 'basins' of the rivers, so no change is needed. Item 16: 'informasi lainnya' should be 'informasi tambahan', since the original says additional information.

kryptopterus-vitreolus.name: Lele kaca
notes: "karena arah cahaya dan gerakan ikan harus pas betul" – the source says "the interaction of light and movement of the fish must fit exactly"; consider "interaksi cahaya dan gerakan ikan harus pas" to stay closer to the original.

"seorang penghobi bergelar sarjana biologi" – the source says "a keeper with a degree in biology"; fine in meaning, but "pemelihara" or "aquascaper" is not needed. Keep "penghobi" and consider "lulusan biologi" as more natural.
"Dari kebiasaan ini" – the source says "In this context"; "Dalam kegiatan ini" would be more faithful, since it was not a habit that led to the discovery.

labidochromis-caeruleus.name: Labidochromis caeruleus
notes: Item 11: "cichlid Danau Rift" reads as if the lake is called Rift. Use "cichlid danau-danau Rift Valley" or "cichlid Great Rift Lakes".
Item 10: "memuntahkan telur/burayak" mixes two terms. Use "memuntahkan telur atau burayak".
Item 7: "mau menerima sebagian besar pakan" is slightly stiff. Use "mau memakan sebagian besar jenis pakan".

macropodus-opercularis.name: Ikan Paradise
notes: Item 12: "cacing sutra" for "blackworms" is inexact. Cacing sutra is usually Tubifex, and blackworms are Lumbriculus. Use "blackworm" or "cacing hitam".
Item 8: "kayu apung" for "Driftwood" can be read as wood that floats. Use "kayu driftwood" or "kayu rendaman".
Item 14: "urutan hierarki" is redundant for "pecking order". Use "hierarki dominansi" or "urutan dominansi".
Item 2: "LC (Risiko Rendah)" would be better as "Berisiko Rendah", the usual Indonesian wording for Least Concern.

marosatherina-ladigesi.name: Beseng-beseng
notes: #10: "bertelur beberapa butir setiap hari" adds "a few"; the source says only "batches of eggs each day" (e.g. "bertelur dalam beberapa kelompok setiap hari" or just "bertelur setiap hari").
#10: "pakan yang melayang" for "free swimming foods" is slightly off; "pakan hidup yang aktif berenang" would be closer.
#1/#11: "peternakan (ikan)" for fish farms is unusual; hobbyists say "tempat budidaya" or "penangkaran".
#7: "ia mau menerima" is stiff; "mau memakan" is more natural.

mastacembelus-armatus.name: Tilan Tire Track
notes: Item 5: "spiny eel sering suka membenamkan diri" is redundant (sering + suka); use "sering membenamkan diri" or "cenderung suka".
Item 5: "air payau ringan" is awkward; use "air payau dengan salinitas rendah" (or "sedikit payau").

Item 1/11: "Tilan tire track" mixes local and English; the English name is left untranslated and the Indonesian term "tilan" is used inconsistently across items (e.g. "peacock eel" and "Tanganyikan spiny eel" stay in English). Consider "belut duri" or "tilan" consistently, with English in brackets.
Item 5: "Tutup akuarium yang rapat wajib dipakai" is stiff; rephrase to "Akuarium wajib ditutup rapat".
Item 7: "lancefish" and "krill" are left in English without a gloss; add "ikan lancefish (sand lance)" or a local equivalent.
Item 7: "menopang ikan yang sudah besar" is awkward; use "memenuhi kebutuhan gizi ikan yang sudah besar".
Item 4: "Panjang standar 91 cm" is correct, but the volume is stated without litre/gallon context. This is fine, so no change is needed here beyond smoothing the wording.
Item 3: "sungai kecil" for "streams" is fine, but "sungai kecil maupun besar" slightly changes "streams and rivers"; use "anak sungai dan sungai".

mastacembelus-erythrotaenia.name: Fire Eel
notes: Item 1/11: "ikan sili (spiny eel)" is a dubious local name. Family Mastacembelidae is usually called "ikan tilan" or "belut duri" (sili is a different fish). Use "tilan"/"belut duri".
Item 5: "ikan sili sering suka membenamkan diri" is redundant (sering suka). Also use the same term as elsewhere. Suggest "sering membenamkan diri".
Item 5: "ditanami tanaman air dengan rapat" is awkward. Suggest "ditanami cukup rimbun".
Item 7: "lancefish" is left untranslated. Add a local equivalent such as "ikan lance (sand lance)".
Item 8: "teman satu akuarium cukup besar" is fine, but "sesamanya" for conspecifics is vague. Use "sesama spesiesnya".
Item 10: "berhasil berkembang biak" is stronger than the source. Suggest "pernah berkembang biak" or "memijah". Also change "Sesekali pernah" to "Pernah sesekali".
Item 4: "±432 liter" uses ± where the source has ~. Use "sekitar 432 liter".

maylandia-estherae.name: Red Zebra
notes: Item 10: "Care must be taken, if you decide to move the fish... harassment by the males" is rendered as "memindahkan betina... betina tidak diganggu jantan", which narrows the meaning. The source says the fish in general, not only the female.

Item 10: "dissipate this aggression" became "menyebarkan agresi". That is fine, but the sentence "Jantan cukup agresif saat mengejar betina" slightly changes the nuance of "quite vigorous in his pursuits".
Item 10: "Maternal mouthbrooder" became "pengeram mulut induk betina". This is awkward; use "pengeram mulut (mouthbrooder) oleh induk betina".

Item 10: "Some breeders artificially strip the fry... at the 2 week stage" became "mengeluarkan burayak secara paksa". "Secara paksa" is too harsh for an artificial method; use "secara manual/buatan".
Item 11: "Mbuna yang memang pantas populer" is stiff. Use "Mbuna yang populer dan memang layak".

Item 11: "jantan oranye dan OB" (item 1) says "orange and OB males occur", but "yellow or OB females" is missing from item 1. That is acceptable as a summary, but the item 11 and item 1 colour descriptions are inconsistent.
Item 8: "The tank should be overcrowded" was rendered with the English term "(overcrowded)" in brackets. "Padat tebar" would be the more natural hobby term.
Item 8: "peace loving species" became "spesies yang damai". The wording is fine, but "Peacock atau Utaka" should be clarified as cichlid groups.
Item 3: "karang-karang batu" is awkward for "reefs" in a freshwater lake. Use "area bebatuan/terumbu batu".
Item 1: "bisa kawin silang (hibrida)" is a clumsy use of the noun "hibrida". Use "bisa berhibridisasi".

melanotaenia-boesemani.name: Rainbow Boesemani
notes: Item 8: "ikan lele seperti Corydoras" is imprecise. Hobbyists would write "corydoras" or "lele hias (catfish) seperti Corydoras".
Item 10: "pakan yang melayang di air" for "free swimming foods" is slightly off. Better "pakan hidup yang berenang bebas seperti naupli artemia".
Item 11: "sangat dirugikan oleh perdagangan ikan hias" is a little loose. A clearer rendering is "perdagangan ikan hias berdampak sangat buruk pada spesies ini".

melanotaenia-praecox.name: Rainbow Praecox
notes: Item 10: 'filter kecil bertenaga aerator (filter busa/sponge)' adds a fact not in the source (sponge filter). Say 'filter kecil berpenggerak udara'.
Item 10: 'pakan yang melayang di air' for 'free swimming foods' changes the meaning. It should be live food that moves freely, such as 'pakan hidup yang berenang bebas'.

Item 10: 'Jumlah burayak per pemijahan biasanya sedikit lebih banyak' is a slightly altered reading. The source says brood size is a little larger than other rainbowfish. Wording should be 'jumlah anakan'.
Item 8: 'ikan karakin (tetra dan sejenisnya)' adds a gloss not in the source. Use 'karasin' or just 'characin'.
Item 8: 'gampang kaget' and 'ikan lele-lelean' are casual. Use 'mudah kaget' and 'lele seperti Corydoras'.
Item 1: 'Neon dwarf rainbowfish' is left untranslated. Add the local name 'ikan pelangi neon kerdil' or 'pelangi neon'.
Item 1: 'Papua (Pulau Nugini)' differs from the source's 'New Guinea', and Mamberamo is in Papua. It is correct but an added detail; keep it consistent.
Item 9: 'badan jantan menjadi jauh lebih tinggi' is acceptable but 'lebih tinggi' may be read as height; 'berbadan lebih dalam/lebar' is clearer.

microdevario-kubotai.name: Rasbora Kubotai
notes: Item 6: the English sentence 'In the Suriya the water is well-oxygenated, slightly turbid' is rendered correctly, but 'Such habitats tend to comprise transparent water' became 'berair jernih'. That is fine. The real problem is item 8: 'biologically immature set-up' became 'siklus nitrogennya belum matang'. This adds detail, but it is acceptable. A fuller fix is 'akuarium yang belum matang secara biologis'.

Item 1: 'maximum size of around 2.5 to 4 cm (1 to 1.5 inches)' was kept as 2,5–4 cm. That is correct. However, 'kadang bisa cukup merepotkan' for 'can make them difficult at times' is vague. Use 'kadang sulit dipelihara'.
Item 3: 'Mae Khlong and Mae Klong' are the same river spelled two ways. 'daerah aliran anak sungai Mae Khlong dan Mae Klong' reads oddly, but it matches the source, so leave it.

Item 4: the type locality is left entirely in English, including the coordinate '98°41'11'E'. It is untranslated English in running text. Translate the descriptive words ('Khlong Phrae Sai di Ban Kreo Noi, kilometer 8 pada jalan bercabang ke timur, 32 kilometer di utara Ranong ...') and keep the place names.
Item 4: 'daerah hulu Khwae Noi' for 'upper Khwae Noi watershed' drops 'watershed'. Use 'daerah aliran Sungai Khwae Noi bagian hulu'.
Item 11: 'aquascape hardscape' is awkward and does not mean a hardscape-only tank. Use 'akuarium dengan hardscape (batu dan kayu)'.
Item 15: 'paling baik dipelihara sendiri (tanpa spesies lain)' is slightly ambiguous. 'sendiri' could be read as a single fish. Use 'dipelihara satu spesies saja'.
Item 16: 'bertubuh lebih tinggi' for 'deeper-bodied' is acceptable. 'lebih ramping' for the males is not in the source ('more compact'). Use 'lebih kompak'.
Item 7: 60 × 30 cm base at 54 litres is plausible only for a ~30 cm tall tank. Check that the figure matches the source.

mikrogeophagus-ramirezi.name: Ramirezi
notes: Item 8: "sekitar 60 cm" for "a couple of feet across" is acceptable, but "lebar" is odd; use "berdiameter sekitar 60 cm".
Item 9: "kemerahmudaan" is non-standard and awkward; use "bercak merah muda".
Item 5: "siklus nitrogennya belum matang" is fine, but "biologically immature" is more commonly "belum matang secara biologis / belum cycling"; consider adding "(cycling)".
Item 5: "tidak satu pun berasal dari Amerika Selatan" is correct; "ganti air dalam jumlah sangat besar sebaiknya dihindari" reads clumsy, use "hindari pergantian air dalam volume sangat besar".
Item 10: "memakan telur atau anaknya" adds "or fry" (source says brood, so acceptable), but "mikroworm" should be "cacing mikro (microworm)".
Item 7: "kutu air" for Daphnia is acceptable, but "Daphnia" is the usual hobby term; "kerang-kerangan" for shellfish is vague (could include crustaceans), use "kerang dan udang-udangan/seafood".
Item 11: "klad" is unusual for hobbyists; use "klade". "Kullander (1998) memakai Mikrogeophagus ... sedangkan Microgeophagus sensu Frey ..." slightly alters the sentence flow but meaning kept.
Item 1: "Ram atau ramirezi" adds a name not in the source ("The ram"); acceptable but could be "Ram" only.

moenkhausia-sanctaefilomenae.name: Red Eye Tetra
notes: Item 11: "pada sore atau malam hari" adds "sore"; the English says only "in the evening", so use "pada malam hari" or "menjelang malam".
Item 3: "Inggris" for "the UK" is slightly imprecise; "Britania Raya" or "Inggris (UK)" would be more exact.

monodactylus-sebae.name: Mono Sebae
notes: Item 1: "bisa berpindah dengan bebas" is fine, but "hasil penangkaran" for "offspring" is acceptable; consider "keturunan hasil budidaya" for naturalness.
Item 2: "sudah memijah" for "are spawning" is okay; "troop" rendered as "kelompok" is fine, but consider "gerombolan" (schooling term) for hobby usage.

Item 5: "memijah bebas tanpa merawat anakan" — "free spawners" is better as "penebar telur (free spawner) tanpa perawatan induk"; "telurnya melayang bebas" slightly changes "spawn swims around" (spawn here may mean eggs/larvae, which swim), so use "telur/larva berenang di air".

monopterus-albus.name: Belut sawah
notes: Item 7: "lancefish" is left as English with no explanation; consider adding a local equivalent or a short gloss such as "ikan lancefish (sand lance)".
Item 11: "belut rawa" (for swamp eels) and "belut sawah" (for the same species elsewhere) are used inconsistently; pick one name.

myxocyprinus-asiaticus.name: Chinese Hi-Fin Banded Shark
notes: "Semua ikan yang diperdagangkan berasal dari budi daya dan merupakan hasil penangkaran" is redundant; budi daya and penangkaran say the same thing. Use one, e.g. "berasal dari hasil penangkaran/budi daya".
"mighty dorsal fin" became "sirip punggung besar", which loses the sense of a strong or imposing fin. Consider "sirip punggung yang megah/kokoh".
"semua ikan ini yang beredar di perdagangan" is awkward word order. Use "semua ikan jenis ini yang beredar di perdagangan" or similar.
"Chinese Whimple Carp" and "Batman-Loach" are left in English with no local name or explanation. Consider adding a note that this is a trade name, or italicise it.
"tahan menghadapi musim dingin" is clumsy. Use "tahan musim dingin" or "dapat bertahan di musim dingin di Eropa Tengah".

"Myxocyprinus" is the genus name, but the ID text does not give the full species name. This is fine if the source also omits it. Check that the genus is not mixed up with the common name "Chinese Whimple Carp".

nematobrycon-lacortei.name: Rainbow Tetra
notes: Item 10: "pada sore menjelang malam" – English says "in the evening"; fine, but "Konon cara berkembang biaknya" is slightly awkward; prefer "Dikatakan berbiak dengan cara serupa...".
Item 8: "cocok sekali menjadi penghuni akuarium komunitas yang komposisi penghuninya sudah direncanakan dengan baik" is wordy for "well-researched community aquarium"; simplify.
Item 8: "hasilnya berupa tontonan yang tampak lebih alami" is a bit awkward; "Anda akan dihadiahi pemandangan yang tampak lebih alami".
Item 5: "Pilihan dekorasi tidak terlalu menentukan" is awkward; use "Pilihan dekorasi tidak terlalu penting".

Item 11: "jumlah jari-jari sirip dada yang paling umum" OK, but "gasteropelecid, lebiasinid, callichthyid, loricariid" left as English family terms; consider Indonesian-style wording (e.g. "lele Callichthyidae").

oryzias-latipes.name: Medaka
notes: Item 8: "Sebagian besar tidak agresif terhadap Oryzias lain" is ambiguous. Say clearly whether it means the same species or other Oryzias species.
Item 11: "ikan gigi (toothcarp)" is not a common hobby term. Use "ikan gigi" with the Cyprinodontiformes context, or keep "toothcarp" alone.
Item 5: "Paling baik dipelihara di akuarium yang penuh tanaman air" is slightly stronger than "heavily planted". "Akuarium dengan banyak tanaman" would be more natural.

osphronemus-goramy.name: Gurami
notes: Item 1: 'Gurami, Osphronemus goramy' - 'giant gourami' translated as just 'Gurami'; use 'Gurami raksasa' or 'Gurame' to keep 'giant' (same in item 1 first sentence 'gurami berukuran besar').
Item 4: '72" x 24" x 24"' = 183 × 61 × 61 cm is correct, but 'Volume: ~681 liter' fine; no issue otherwise. Consider noting minimum tank depth/height explicitly.
Item 5: 'luar biasa jorok' is awkward/colloquial for 'exceptionally messy'; use 'sangat banyak menghasilkan kotoran'.
Item 5: 'Tanaman apung sebaiknya ada' is vague; the source says floating plants are preferable (as cover) - use 'Tanaman apung lebih disarankan'.
Item 8: 'ikan sapu-sapu (loricariid)' fine, but 'lele besar' for 'large catfish' acceptable; 'teman setangki' is non-standard, use 'ikan penghuni lain'.

Item 10: 'Pemijahan terjadi di sekitar sarang' fine, but 'burayak' for fry is OK; 'matang kelamin' acceptable. Item 10: 'Jantan membangun sarang ... (di alam termasuk rumput dan akar)' garbles 'including grasses and roots in nature'; use 'termasuk rumput dan akar di alam'.
Item 11: 'sangat membuat ikan stres' is awkward; use 'sangat membuat ikan stres' -> 'menyebabkan stres berat pada ikan'.

Item 11: 'Gurami sering dijual' - original says 'They' (O. goramy); also 'finnage' rendered as 'siripnya yang merah' loses 'red finnage' nuance slightly (fine). Item 11: 'dying' mistranslation check: 'varian yang diwarnai' correct but 'we strongly advise' became passive 'sangat disarankan' OK.

osteoglossum-bicirrhosum.name: Arwana Silver
notes: Item 8: "buah yang jatuh ke air" adds "ke air", which isn't in the source ("fallen nuts and fruits"). Use "buah dan biji-bijian yang berjatuhan".
Item 8: "kacang-kacangan" for "nuts" is slightly off for forest fruit; "biji-bijian" or "buah berkulit keras" fits better.
Item 10/2: "anakan" and "burayak" are mixed for fry/juveniles. Use "burayak" for fry and "anakan" for juveniles consistently.
Item 11: "sirip dubur" is correct but hobbyists more often write "sirip anal".

pangasianodon-hypophthalmus.name: Patin siam
notes: Item 10: "di peternakan ikan di Asia Timur dan Tenggara" adds "dan Tenggara", which the source ("Far Eastern fish farms") doesn't say. Use "Asia Timur", or a neutral "di Asia". Also prefer "tambak/kolam budidaya ikan" over "peternakan ikan".

Item 10: "akhir musim semi dan musim panas" is a literal rendering of the seasons. Indonesian readers may find it unnatural, since the Mekong's seasons are better described as the end of the dry season and the start of the rainy season. Consider a note or a neutral rewording.
Item 11: "sekitar satu meter" turns "a few feet" into one figure. "Beberapa kaki" is roughly 0.9–1.5 m, so "sekitar 1 meter atau lebih" is safer.

paracheirodon-axelrodi.name: Cardinal Tetra
notes: Item 9: EN says '20 gallons (about 75 litres)'. ID gives 'sekitar 75 liter'. This is acceptable, but the 54 L figure in item 8 conflicts with 75 L. That conflict is in the source, so ignore it.

Item 5: 'Since overfishing this quick-replenishing species would be nearly impossible' became 'hampir mustahil ditangkap berlebihan'. This is fine. However, 'anak Sungai Amazon' for 'Rio Negro tributary of the Amazon' is ambiguous. Reword it as 'Rio Negro, anak sungai Amazon'.
Item 20: EN says 'transfer them to the spawning tank in the evening'. ID says 'pada sore atau malam hari', which adds 'sore'. Use 'pada malam hari'.

Item 21: EN says 'They spawn in the evening'. ID says 'pada sore atau malam hari', which adds 'sore'. Use 'pada malam hari'. Also, 'paling banter bisa dibilang menantang' is awkward for 'challenging at best'. Use 'paling tidak menantang' or 'cukup sulit'.
Item 3: 'garis merahnya' is OK. 'tidak secerah aslinya' adds 'aslinya'. EN says 'isn't as vibrant', so leave it as 'kurang cerah'. Also, 'a hook protruding' in item 19 is fine.
Item 3: 'The red band extends the entire length of the body' and 'while in the neon tetra it runs only from mid-body to tail' are correct. No change needed.
Item 22: 'Hypessobrycon simulans' and 'P. inessi' keep source typos. Latin names must stay as they are, so no change.
Item 6: 'Pada musim kemarau... Saat hujan musim penghujan' is awkward. Write 'Saat musim hujan mulai'. 'Hampir sebagai ikan semusim (annual)' is acceptable.
Item 22: 'garis kromatofor ... yang meluas ke arah punggung' is acceptable. 'incertae sedis' is fine.
Item 17: Item 17's 'Lele kecil, terutama Corydoras' is fine. In item 16, 'tidak predator' is non-standard. Use 'bukan pemangsa'. 'lele callichthyid' is fine.

paracheirodon-innesi.name: Neon tetra
notes: #3 "warnanya tegas" for "robustly colored" is slightly odd; "warnanya cerah/pekat" is more natural.
#3 "farm/budidaya ikan" is mixed; use just "peternakan/budidaya ikan".
#9 "kimia airnya stabil" is stiff; "parameter air stabil" is more natural.

paracheirodon-simulans.name: Green Neon Tetra
notes: Item 22: 'a lesser (vs. greater) amount of relatively duller red pigmentation' – the Indonesian reads 'warna merah ... lebih sedikit (bukan lebih banyak) dan relatif lebih kusam', which is fine; but 'lateral stripe' rendered as 'garis lateral' is confusable with the lateral line (garis rusuk). Use 'garis samping/pita lateral' consistently throughout.

Item 22: 'a stripe of dark brown or black chromatophores underlying and extending dorsally to the lateral stripe' became 'berada di bawah garis lateral dan memanjang ke arah punggung', which is garbled. It should say the dark stripe lies beneath the lateral stripe and extends dorsally to it.
Item 22: 'Kalau kebanyakan characid ... garis yang lebih terang di atasnya' is acceptable, but 'Hypessobrycon' is kept as the source's spelling. Check it against 'Hyphessobrycon'.

Item 3: 'smallest and tiniest species' was condensed to 'paling kecil'. Also 'This is the reason why some people call ... blue neon' loses the logic. Make clear that the confusion with the other 'green neon' is why people use 'blue neon'.
Item 1: 'garisnya yang hijau toska mengilap dengan warna pekat' is awkward. Use 'garis hijau toska iridesen yang intens'.
Item 12: 'biologically-immature aquaria' became 'siklus nitrogennya belum matang'. This is acceptable, but 'alder cones' as 'buah alder' is odd. Use 'kerucut alder (alder cone)'.
Item 20: 'Eggs are scattered among plants' is fine, but 'agar telur tidak dimakan' changes 'to prevent predation' slightly. Say 'agar telur tidak dimangsa'.
Item 21: The register shifts to 'Mereka tumbuh subur', while the preceding sentence says 'Ikan ini'. Make the pronouns consistent.

parambassis-ranga.name: Ikan Kaca
notes: Item 10: 'in the evening' became 'di sore atau malam hari' – adds 'or night'; keep just 'pada sore hari'.
Item 10: 'burayak' is used for fry; it's acceptable, but 'anakan ikan' is more commonly used by hobbyists – consider consistency.
Item 10: 'kondisi air tetap sempurna' is stiff; use 'kondisi air tetap prima/optimal'.
Item 8: 'vigorous or aggressive species' rendered 'terlalu aktif atau agresif' – 'terlalu' is added; use 'aktif/lincah atau agresif'.
Item 11: 'secara buatan' (artificially) is awkward; and 'ikan yang dicat' for 'painted fish' loses the trade-name sense; keep 'painted' in quotes.
Item 1: 'peternakan ikan' for fish farms is odd; use 'tempat budidaya ikan' or 'farm ikan'.
Item 11: 'Ranga punya area gelap...' and 'Lala' lack species-name clarity; write 'C. ranga' and 'P. lala' for consistency.
Item 4: converted litres '72 liter' fine, but 'dimensions ... should be the smallest considered' is OK; nothing to fix.
Item 2: 'Diintroduksi' is stiff; use 'Diintroduksi' → 'Telah dimasukkan ke' (introduced to Japan and Hong Kong).

pelvicachromis-pulcher.name: Kribensis
notes: Item 8: "sangat agresif" for "very vigorous" shifts meaning; use "sangat aktif/lincah" (or "aktif dan agresif").
Item 8: "characin kecil (seperti tetra)" adds a gloss not in the source; remove it or just keep "characin kecil".
Item 7: "Mau menerima hampir semua jenis pakan" is stiff; use "Menerima hampir semua jenis pakan" or "Mau makan hampir semua jenis pakan".

pethia-conchonius.name: Rosy barb
notes: Item 2: temperature range converted to metric is fine, but 'Minimum tank size: 30 gallons (about 110 litres)' is converted correctly; however 'Adult size: 6 inches (15 cm)' is OK. No error there.
Item 7: '20-gallon' ≈ 76 L, so 'sekitar 75 liter' is OK, but the text is consistent only if 30 gallons = 110 L; fine.
Item 19: 'a 20- or 30-gallon aquarium' became 'sekitar 75 atau 110 liter'; fine. 'sexual maturity at approximately 6 cm (2.5 inches)' OK.
Item 15: 'swordtails' translated as 'platy pedang (swordtail)' is wrong; platy and swordtail are different fish. Use 'ikan pedang (swordtail)'.
Item 15: 'angelfish' translated as 'manfish (angelfish)'; manfish is the Indonesian name for Pterophyllum, but 'ikan manfish' could be ambiguous. Minor: keep as is or write 'angelfish (manfish)'.
Item 15: 'knifefish, ropefish' and 'dither fish' left in English without Indonesian explanation; add a brief gloss (e.g. 'ikan pengalih/dither fish').
Item 15: 'Rosy barbs are agile and can outswim' is rendered OK. 'Teman satu akuarium' fine.
Item 20: 'it's possible that small numbers of fry' OK. 'one or two pairs should then be introduced' became passive without 'should'; the instruction 'induk harus dipindahkan' is OK.
Item 20: 'half a dozen specimens of each sex' rendered 'masing-masing enam ekor dari tiap jenis kelamin' is fine.
Item 22: 'infraorbital 3 deep' translated 'tulang infraorbital 3 lebar' - 'deep' means tinggi/dalam (depth), not 'lebar'; change to 'tinggi'. Also 'preoperculum' → 'preoperkulum' acceptable.

phenacogrammus-interruptus.name: Congo Tetra
notes: Item 17: "sirip yang lebih megah" and "sirip megah" for "elaborate fins" is slightly odd. Use "sirip yang lebih panjang dan rumit" or "sirip yang lebih indah".
Item 4: "Galur ini stabil secara turun-temurun" for "breed true" reads stiffly. Something like "sifat warnanya menurun dengan baik pada keturunannya" would be more natural.

phractocephalus-hemioliopterus.name: Red Tail Catfish
notes: "ikan lancefish": English name left untranslated; use "ikan sandeel/lancefish (Ammodytes)" with a short gloss, or a local equivalent.
"batu koral besar yang halus": "koral" suggests coral. Use "kerikil/kerakal besar yang halus" or "batu sungai besar yang halus".
"ikan monster" for "tankbusters": unclear. Use "ikan raksasa/ikan besar yang biasa dipelihara (tankbuster)".
"sampai mereka menolak menerima lagi": "mereka" is ambiguous. Say "sampai akuarium publik menolak menerima lagi".

piaractus-brachypomus.name: Bawal air tawar
notes: Item 1: "Akibat ikan yang dilepas oleh para penghobi, kini ada populasinya" is awkward. Say instead "akibat pelepasan oleh penghobi, populasinya kini ditemukan di Amerika Serikat dan tempat lain".
Item 1: "Red-bellied pacu" is left in English as the sentence subject. Use an Indonesian name such as "Pacu perut merah", with the English name in brackets if wanted.
Item 6: "sudah oke" is too casual for a handbook. Use "sudah sesuai" or "dapat diterima".
Item 11: "Karena itu, penjualan spesies ini kemudian dilarang" adds a causal link the English does not have. Use "Spesies ini kemudian juga dilarang dijual...".
Item 11: "Giginya bertonjolan" is a poor rendering of "cusped". Use "bergerigi/berpuncak" or "memiliki tonjolan (cusp)".
Item 5: "dipasang kuat pada akuarium dengan cara tertentu" is clumsy. Say "difiksasi/dikunci pada akuarium dengan cara tertentu".

poecilia-latipinna.name: Molly Sailfin
notes: Item 1/4: "125 mm SL" kept in mm; fine, but "Max size" bracketed 5 in dropped is okay. No issue.
Item 5: "cukup sadah atau lebih sadah" is awkward; use "berkesadahan sedang hingga tinggi".
Item 5: "mineral \"sadah\"" is awkward; use "mineral penyebab kesadahan" for the "hard" minerals.
Item 5: "gerakan bergoyang-goyang di tempat (shimmying)" is fine, but "sirip yang menguncup" is better as "sirip menguncup/mengatup" - minor.
Item 7: "Di alam, ikan ini hampir sepenuhnya herbivor" okay; "pakan serpihan sayuran" fine. "menunya" is slightly colloquial.
Item 8: "Teman setangki" is non-standard; use "penghuni akuarium lain / tank mate". "catfish" is acceptable, though "ikan lele-lelean" is less common.
Item 10: "Masa bunting" is used for mammals; use "masa kehamilan/masa mengandung" or "induk bunting" is common among hobbyists, so minor. "burayak" and "anakan" are mixed; keep consistent ("anakan").
Item 10: "hingga 50 anak" okay; "kemungkinannya memakan anaknya sendiri" ok. "tipe liar ... bentuk domestik" is fine.
Item 3: "yang banyak vegetasinya" modifies awkwardly; use "yang banyak ditumbuhi vegetasi".
Item 2: "mapan" for "established" is unusual; use "telah berkembang biak dan menetap".

poecilia-reticulata.name: Guppy
notes: Item 7: "sekitar 1,5 liter air untuk setiap 1 cm panjang ikan" – the conversion is wrong. 1 gallon per 1 inch is about 3.8 L / 2.54 cm ≈ 1,5 L per cm, so this is actually fine. However, 'tanpa heater' text is OK. The real problem is 'minimal sekitar 40 liter': the English says 'Minimum 10 gallons', so drop 'sekitar'.

Item 20: "sebaiknya induk dipindahkan setelah burayak lahir" – the English says remove the young ('remove them' = fry), and the Indonesian says move the parent fish. Change to 'sebaiknya burayak dipindahkan'/'induk dipisahkan' to match; as written it reverses the meaning and the 100% survival logic.
Item 20: "gestation takes between 4-6 weeks" – 'masa kehamilan' is OK, but 'Excess viable sperm ... preserved' is rendered fine. 'Seekor betina bisa menghasilkan 5–100 anak' is OK.
Item 9: "soft décor items" translated as "dekorasi yang lembut" – unnatural; use 'dekorasi yang tidak tajam/halus'.
Item 9: "banyak sekat plastik tipis" – 'many flimsy plastic dividers' means most flimsy dividers; rephrase as 'sekat plastik tipis pada umumnya'.
Item 16: "sumatra (tiger barb)" – OK, but 'serpae tetra' leaves English; acceptable.
Item 3: "hasil ternakan" and 'Fantail' etc. are fine; 'yang katanya tidak ada di tempat lain' adds a skeptical nuance ('katanya') not in the source – use 'yang tidak ditemukan di tempat lain'.
Item 22: "membeli indukan berkualitas" – English says 'quality stock'; 'indukan' (broodstock) narrows the meaning; use 'ikan berkualitas'.
Item 15: "zebrafish" rendered as "zebra danio" – acceptable, but 'ikan yang aktif berbiak' is an addition; use 'guppy betina yang beranak'.

poecilia-sphenops.name: Molly
notes: Item 1/10: "tidak sadah dan tidak basa" is awkward; use "tidak sadah dan tidak beralkali (pH rendah)", e.g. "air tawar yang lunak dan cenderung asam"; "not hard and alkaline" means soft/acidic water.
Item 4: "wajib dipelihara" is too strong for "must be maintained"; "harus" would be more natural.
Item 4: "sirip menguncup" is fine, but "clamped fins" is usually "sirip mengatup/menguncup"; keep it consistent.
Item 4: "mineral 'kesadahan'" is slightly awkward; use "mineral penyebab kesadahan".
Item 3: "Alas akuarium" is unusual; use "Ukuran dasar akuarium" or "Dimensi alas".
Item 3: The final "90 × 30 × 30 cm" is left bare; clarify it as the tank dimensions.
Item 9: "dipijahkan" is imprecise for livebearers; use "dikembangbiakkan".
Item 9: "kotak beranak" for breeding traps is fine, but "jaring" should read "jaring pembesaran".
Item 10: "menjalankan siklus akuarium laut" is awkward; use "mematangkan (cycling) akuarium laut baru".
Item 10: "cacat" for "malformed" is fine, but "bentuk tubuhnya tidak normal" is more neutral.

poecilia-wingei.name: Guppy Endler
notes: Item 5: "sangat hangat dan sadah" is fine, but item 8: "tidak cocok... dipelihara sendiri" okay; main problem in item 4: "unto Carupano" -> "hingga Carupano" is fine, but "Hidup di perairan tawar" fine.

Item 7: "Ukuran akuarium minimal 19–38 liter" - fine; item 14: "yang tidak cukup besar untuk memangsa mereka" reverses meaning; English says fish too big to eat them -> "yang cukup besar sehingga tidak memangsa mereka / terlalu besar untuk dimakan" (should be 'terlalu besar untuk dimakan Endler'? actually: fish big enough that Endlers cannot eat... clarify: 'cukup besar sehingga tidak memakan mereka').
Item 18: "Induk memakan anaknya sendiri" drops nuance; ok. "Burayak Endler biasanya awalnya hanya sedikit berwarna" redundant 'biasanya awalnya' - reword.
Item 17: "produktif" fine; "pelihara beberapa betina untuk setiap jantan" fine. 'anakan baru' vs 'burayak' inconsistent term.
Item 15: "bunting" for fish is inappropriate; use "bunting" -> "hamil/mengandung (gravid)" common hobby term 'bunting' is acceptable but better 'bunting' consistent.

Item 19: "Dr. Endler ... lokasi pengambilan" okay; "ditetapkan secara jelas" for "unequivocally defined" ok. "Kedua spesies ini asli wilayah" missing "adalah" -> "Kedua spesies ini asli dari wilayah".
Item 1: "hobiis" is non-standard; use "penghobi" or "kalangan hobi akuarium".
Item 2: "Males ... carry the vibrant colours" ok. Item 3: "Endler liar" ok; "strain" fine.
Item 8: "Arus air bukan masalah" fine; redundant repeated "dipelihara" in last sentence.

polypterus-senegalus.name: Polypterus Senegal
notes: Item 11: "melengkungkan sirip anal dan sirip ekornya di sekitar alat kelamin betina" – 'cupping' is better rendered as 'membentuk cekungan/mengapit' with the fins; 'melengkungkan' is slightly off.
Item 12: "kelompok polypterid 'rahang atas'" – 'tribe' is rendered vaguely; consider 'suku/kelompok berahang atas'.
Item 9: "Tidak bisa dipercaya bersama teman setangki yang muat di mulutnya" is awkward; better 'Tidak boleh dicampur dengan ikan yang muat di mulutnya'.
Item 12: "Seperti spesies Anabantoid" – use the common term 'ikan labirin (anabantoid)'.
Item 2/12: 'Senegal bichir' left untranslated, fine, but 'cichlid' in item 8 could be 'pelet untuk cichlid'; minor.
Item 12: 'meridionalis ... Perlu dicatat' fine; 'indra penciumannya yang sangat tajam' ok.

poropanchax-normani.name: Normani Lampeye
notes: "asal jangan salah memelihara terlalu sedikit ekor" is awkward; better: "hindari kesalahan memelihara terlalu sedikit ekor" or "jangan memelihara terlalu sedikit"."
"Kalau sendirian... Tapi" is rather colloquial for a handbook; use "Jika dilihat satu ekor saja... Namun"."
"akuarium bergaya nature aquarium" is redundant; use "akuarium bergaya alam (nature aquarium)"."
"hasil budi daya dari Indonesia" is fine, but "Mata birunya melayang-layang" slightly changes "drift"; consider "melayang".

prionobrama-filigera.name: Glass Bloodfin Tetra
notes: Item 14: 'pada sore/malam hari' – English says 'in the evening'; 'sore/malam' is a hedge, use 'pada malam hari' (or 'menjelang malam').

Item 14: 'Ukuran sekitar 46 × 25 × 25 cm' – 18x10x10 in = 45.7×25.4×25.4 cm, OK; but 'enam ekor dari masing-masing jenis kelamin' drops 'half a dozen specimens ... being a good number' nuance (minor).
Item 11: 'cenderung kurang berkembang baik' is awkward; better 'cenderung kurang baik/kurang sehat bila persaingan ... ketat'.

Item 11: 'angelfish' rendered as 'manfish' – Indonesian hobbyists say 'manfish' but 'angelfish' is also common; acceptable, though 'lele Loricariidae' for Loricariid catfish is odd; use 'ikan lele Loricariidae/sapu-sapu kecil'.
Item 8: 'Penambahan ... bisa menghasilkan tata akuarium' fine; 'ranting beech dan oak yang sudah dikupas juga boleh' ok. 'agak mudah kaget' acceptable.
Item 9: 'Hardness: Up to 30 °H' kept as '°H' – fine; 'Kesadahan' ok.
Item 3: 'Hardly ever a wild-collected specimen' – ok.
Item 15: 'Spesies itu kemungkinan belum pernah diimpor' – English 'probably never been imported'; 'belum pernah' is fine, but 'ikan ikutan' for bycatch is non-standard; use 'tangkapan sampingan'.

pristella-maxillaris.name: X-ray tetra
notes: #8: "teman setangki yang sangat agresif" changes "boisterous" (rowdy, lively). Use "sangat lincah/heboh" instead of "agresif".
#10: "pada sore atau malam hari" adds "sore". The English says only "in the evening", so use "pada malam hari" or "menjelang malam".
#7: "Ikan ini mikropredator" is missing the copula. Write "Ikan ini adalah mikropredator" or "Ikan ini seorang pemangsa mikro" is not needed, so use the first.
#5: "Di setup yang sangat polos" leaves "setup" in English. Use "penataan" or "tata letak".
#1: "karasin" is an unusual term for "characid". Use "ikan karasin (characid)" or "tetra".

pseudomugil-furcatus.name: Forktail Blue-eye
notes: Item 25: "seiring bertambahnya usia" is looser than "as they mature"; use "seiring mencapai kedewasaan".
Item 30: "padahal ini termasuk..." adds a contrast the English does not state; "meskipun" or a neutral connector is closer.
Item 21: "saling tantang" for "sparring" is slightly unnatural; "saling berkelahi ringan" or "adu gertak" reads better.

pseudomugil-gertrudae.name: Gertrudae
notes: Item 6: 'Tank size: 10 gallons (about 38 litres) or larger' became 'sekitar 38 liter atau lebih besar'. This is fine, but it conflicts with item 7's 41 L minimum. Check consistency.

Item 18: 'sister group bagi Melanotaeniidae' changes the cladistic statement. The original says Pseudomugilidae plus M. ladigesi form the sister group to Melanotaeniidae. The rewrite is acceptable but wordy. Check that it stays accurate.
Item 18: 'Melanotaeniidae dari Australia dan Papua' for 'Australian and New Guinean'. 'Papua' may be read as the Indonesian province only. Use 'Nugini' or 'Papua Nugini/Pulau Papua'.
Item 8: 'untuk menyebarkan dan melembutkan cahaya' adds 'melembutkan' (soften). Also, '(siklus nitrogennya belum stabil)' is an added gloss. Both are minor additions.
Item 15: 'terutama saat makan' is added and absent from the English ('easily outcompeted'). Remove it.
Item 14: 'gerakan berkilat-kilat yang khas' adds 'yang khas'. Item 16: 'seiring bertambahnya usia' for 'as they mature' should be 'seiring kedewasaan'. Both are minor.

Item 4: 'Rivulet in sago forest...' is left untranslated. Fine as a quoted type locality, but 'sungai dengan Papua bagian barat' is loosely worded. In 'Lokasi yang diketahui', 'sungai Moyle' should be 'Sungai Moyle'.

Item 17: 'bertenaga aerator' is fine. 'ikan tangkapan alam' and 'penangkar' are fine. The sentence 'Metode koloni ini biasanya menghasilkan lebih sedikit burayak' is an interpretation of 'the latter approach is normally less productive', and the referent is ambiguous. It is acceptable.
Item 2: 'dari satu strain hias' is fine. Item 12: 'omnivora' should be 'omnivor' (the common form).

pterophyllum-scalare.name: Manfish
notes: Item 2: "tinggi 20 cm atau lebih" ok, but "mencapai panjang badan 15 cm" fine; main issue elsewhere.
Item 12: "From this a pair is sure to form" translated "hampir pasti" – softens the claim; use "pasti" (faithful) or keep consistent.
Item 7: added "idealnya ... rapat" – "Well planted" means ditanami dengan baik, not "rapat" (densely); added fact.
Item 7: "Amazon Sword" fine, but "minimal 50 cm" refers to tank height; ok. Item 3: "kota/kabupaten (munisipalitas)" is clumsy; use "munisipalitas Santa Isabel" only.
Item 4/5: "Far East" -> "Timur Jauh" is unnatural in Indonesia; use "Asia Timur/Asia Tenggara" or keep "Timur Jauh" cautiously.
Item 12: "saat sedang birahi" is an odd term for fish in breeding condition; use "siap memijah".
Item 13: "berbiak" and "berjodoh" slightly non-standard; use "berkembang biak/memijah" and "pasangan yang sudah terbentuk".
Item 14: "menunjukkan warna merah yang cukup banyak" — "high degree of red" is stronger; use "banyak sekali/dominan"; "kuat" for "stable" is loose.

pterygoplichthys-joselimaianus.name: Pleco L001
notes: Item 4: 'Least Concern (LC)' rendered as 'Risiko Rendah' is acceptable, but 'Di alam spesies ini memang jarang dijumpai' is fine; no issue. Real issue is in item 14: 'peculiar' genera rendered as 'unik' (unique) changes meaning; use 'aneh' or 'khas/tidak lazim'.

Item 14: 'drew the first author's attention' -> 'penulis pertama' keeps the reference to the source's authors; use neutral wording e.g. 'yang menarik perhatian para penulis pertama deskripsi' or drop the reference, as the translator is told to be neutral.

Item 6: 'Glycopterichthys' in the EN is a source variant; fine, but 'catfish yang gagah' leaves English 'catfish' in; use 'ikan lele-lelean/ikan kucing' or 'ikan berkumis'—or at least keep hobby term 'plecos/ikan sapu-sapu'.
Item 8: 'makin ribut' for 'boisterous' is awkward; use 'makin agresif/lincah dan aktif'.
Item 11: 'pakan serpihan, pakan tablet, pakan hidup, dan pakan beku' is repetitive; use 'serpihan (flake), tablet, pakan hidup, dan beku'.
Item 10: 'patut dicatat' is stiff; use 'sangat rakus' / 'nafsu makannya besar'.
Item 3 and 4 name inconsistency Glyptoperichthys vs Pterygoplichthys is from source; fine.

pterygoplichthys-pardalis.name: Ikan sapu-sapu
notes: Item 9: "Dengan ukurannya (lebih dari 40 cm), jumlah pakan yang dihabiskan sangat banyak" is awkward; use "Mengingat ukurannya ... ikan ini menghabiskan pakan dalam jumlah sangat banyak".
Item 3: "makin menyenangkan kalau bisa mendapatkan" is a loose rendering of "All the more beautiful is it to obtain"; consider "terlebih menarik".
Item 10: "setelah besar tidak terlalu" is elliptical; write "tidak terlalu banyak memakan alga".
Item 11: "keliru dijual" is fine, but "peternakan ikan di Timur Jauh" is dated; consider "Asia Timur".

puntigrus-tetrazona.name: Ikan sumatra
notes: Item 14: 'A minimum of seven is highly recommended, and more than 12 is preferred' is kept as is, but it contradicts item 13 (8–10 minimum). This is the source's own inconsistency, so it's fine.
Item 14: 'angelfish (manfish)' is wrong. 'Manfish' is not a standard term for angelfish in Indonesia. Use 'angelfish' or 'ikan manfish' only if that is the established trade name.
Item 14: 'loach dari genus Botia' is slightly off for the English 'Botia loaches'. Fine, but 'Lingkungan seperti ini bisa terlalu membuat stres' is awkward. Use 'terlalu menimbulkan stres'.
Item 12: 'Repashy gel food' is rendered 'pakan gel Repashy', which is fine. 'Roughage' is translated as 'pakan berserat', which is acceptable.

Item 1/19: 'Puntigrus tetrazona' is called 'ikan sumatra' throughout. The usual hobby name is 'ikan sumatra' or 'tiger barb', so this is acceptable. 'cyprinid' is left untranslated; consider 'ikan famili Cyprinidae'.
Item 13: 'boisterous' is translated 'lincah dan bandel'. 'Bandel' (stubborn) adds a meaning not in the source; use 'lincah dan gaduh/ribut'.
Item 13: the English says 'at least 8-10 specimens ... minimum purchase', which is translated correctly. 'Teman setangkinya' is odd; use 'penghuni akuarium lain'.
Item 17: 'six of each sex' is stated as 'masing-masing enam ekor per jenis kelamin'. This is redundant ('half a dozen specimens of each sex'); tidy to 'enam ekor untuk tiap jenis kelamin'.
Item 17: 'air-powered sponge filter' is translated 'filter spons bertenaga aerator'. 'Bertenaga udara' is more accurate.
Item 6: the volume '~72 litres (~19 US gal)' was converted correctly. In item 7, '110-litre (29-gallon)' is kept as 110 liter, which is fine.

puntius-titteya.name: Cherry Barb
notes: Item 21: "half a dozen specimens of each sex" became "enam ekor dari tiap jenis kelamin"; this is acceptable, but "in a mature aquarium" -> "air matang" ("mature water") is ambiguous. Use "air dari akuarium yang sudah matang/established".

Item 23: "free uroneural present" and the "gill rakers" clause are fine, but the item "infraorbital 3 slender" etc. are ok. However "no antrorse predorsal spinous ray" was rendered as "jari-jari duri predorsal yang mengarah ke depan" without the negation scope being clear. Check it.
Item 8: "Kombala" and "wet, evergreen jungle" -> "hutan hujan basah yang selalu hijau" adds "hujan" (rain), which is not in the source. Use "hutan basah yang selalu hijau".

Item 8: "Reports suggest ... have altered" is fine, but "That said, very little of the country's forest cover remains" -> "Meski begitu" loses the contrast with the previous sentence about collection impact. Rephrase it to say that habitat loss is the bigger threat.

Item 6: "leading to overfishing of the most colorful individuals" -> "individu yang paling berwarna banyak ditangkap secara berlebihan" is stiff. Use "ikan yang warnanya paling cerah ditangkap berlebihan".
Item 20: "gender differentiation and development of reproductive products" -> "perbedaan kelamin dan perkembangan sel reproduksi" is odd. Use "pembedaan jenis kelamin dan perkembangan gonad/telur".
Item 2: "top and mid-dweller" -> "Area renang: bagian atas dan tengah" is fine. The imperial figures were dropped as instructed.
Item 4: The translation is left out. The source paragraph about the German breeder, stocklist code 372634 and wholesale-only supply is shop talk, so omitting it is acceptable.
Item 16: "Buenos Aires Tetra" is lowercased as "buenos aires tetra". Capitalise it as "Buenos Aires tetra".
Item 14: "frozen treats" -> "pakan beku sebagai selingan" is fine. "mau menerima" is slightly awkward; use "menerima".

rocio-octofasciata.name: Jack Dempsey
notes: Item 10: "lateral stripe" is rendered "garis samping", which is easily confused with the lateral line ("gurat sisi"). Use "garis memanjang di sisi tubuh" or "pita lateral".
Item 9: "Bertelur di substrat, dan kedua induk ikut menjaga telur dan anakan" adds detail the source lacks (eggs and fry). Prefer "Pemijah substrat dengan perawatan biparental (kedua induk)".
Item 5: "soft, sandy substrate" is rendered "pasir yang halus", which is fine grain, not soft. Use "substrat pasir yang lembut" or "pasir halus tanpa sisi tajam".
Item 10: "Karena itu namanya rupanya dipakai ... karena" repeats "karena". Rephrase, for example "sehingga namanya rupanya dipakai ... mengingat raut wajahnya ...".

sahyadria-denisonii.name: Denisoni
notes: Item 5: "sekitar 243 liter" – 120×45 cm base alone doesn't give volume; the English figure (about 243 litres) is kept, but check it was derived correctly from the source (likely original gallons/height). Verify the conversion.
Item 11: "gumpalan moss jawa" – use the hobby term "java moss" or "lumut jawa" consistently, not a half-translated form.
Item 13: "garis merah tua" for "scarlet body stripe" – scarlet is bright red ("merah menyala/merah scarlet"); "merah tua" means dark red and contradicts the next clause "lebih cerah".
Item 13: "tidak adanya tanda hitam di sirip punggung (pada D. chalakkudiensis ada)" – awkward, rephrase as "tanpa tanda hitam di sirip punggung (vs. ada)".
Item 1/12: "Terancam (Endangered)" – Indonesian IUCN term for Endangered is "Genting"; "Terancam" is generic (Threatened).
Item 9: "akuarium komunitas yang direncanakan dengan baik" – "well-researched" means well-planned/researched; acceptable but "burayak" in item 11 is archaic for fry; "anakan" is more common.
Item 2: omitted text includes customer stocklist info (code 369498, wholesale only) – acceptable as shop talk, no fix needed beyond confirming.

scatophagus-argus.name: Ikan kiper
notes: #4: "tidak perlu diberi pakan kotoran" is weaker than the English "should not feed them feces". Use "jangan diberi pakan kotoran" or "sebaiknya tidak diberi".
#4: "Tentu saja" is added and not in the source. Use a neutral connector such as "Namun".
#6: "dahinya yang sangat curam" is slightly awkward. "dahinya yang sangat landai/miring tajam" or "dahi yang sangat membulat/tegak" may read more naturally for a steep forehead profile.

scleropages-formosus.name: Arwana Asia
notes: Item 1/2/3: 'extirpated' is rendered 'punah'; 'punah' means extinct. Use 'hilang dari / tidak lagi ditemukan di sebagian besar wilayah sebarannya' (or 'punah secara lokal').
Item 5: 'biologically-immature aquaria' is rendered 'siklus nitrogennya belum matang'. This is acceptable, but 'akuarium yang belum matang secara biologis (belum cycling)' is closer to the source.
Item 5: 'completely bare set-ups' is rendered 'kosong tanpa dekorasi'. 'Tanpa substrat dan dekorasi' would be more precise.
Item 7: 'small goldfish' is rendered 'ikan mas koki kecil'. Mas koki is the fancy goldfish. Use 'ikan mas koki' or 'goldfish kecil' to be safe.
Item 7: 'feeder fish' is rendered 'ikan umpan'. 'Ikan pakan (feeder)' is the term hobbyists use.
Item 8: 'Termasuk pengeram mulut, dan yang mengerami adalah jantannya' is wordy. Use 'Pengeram mulut oleh induk jantan'.
Item 9: 'dikoleksi dari Pegunungan Schwaner' should read 'ditangkap/diambil dari'. Also, 'masing-masing' is ambiguous about which variant belongs to which province pair.
Item 9: 'Varian green' mixes English and Indonesian. Keep the form names consistent, e.g. 'varian green' in quotes like the others.
Item 6: The °F values are dropped, which is fine because the metric conversion was requested.

scleropages-jardinii.name: Arwana Irian
notes: Item 1: "Ikan lidah tulang" is a literal rendering; hobbyists more commonly use "arwana/ikan lidah tulang (bony tongue)"; consider adding the English term in brackets.
Item 1: "lempeng-lempeng benua yang bergeser" adds the idea of shifting plates; the source says "continental floes" (bongkahan/pecahan benua). Minor.
Item 2: "Keduanya paling jarang diimpor dibandingkan semua jenis arwana lainnya" is awkward; better "Keduanya adalah arwana yang paling jarang diimpor".
Item 2: "akuaris" is non-standard; "aquascaper" or "penghobi akuarium" is more natural. "tempat penangkaran" is fine, but "breeding facilities" could also be "fasilitas penangkaran".
Item 4: "peternakan di Australia" for "breeding farms" is slightly off; use "tempat/penangkaran budidaya" or "farm pembenihan".
Item 3: "agak suka bertengkar" is a bit colloquial; "agak agresif terhadap sesamanya" is more natural for hobby text.

sewellia-breviventralis.name: Sewellia
notes: Item 1: "warnanya berbeda dibandingkan ikan impor yang masih hidup" is slightly awkward; better "ada perbedaan warna dibandingkan ikan impor hidup".
Item 1: "bentuk warna" for "colour form" is awkward; use "varian warna" or "morf warna".
Item 1: "ditangkap di provinsi Hue" is fine, but "Karena itu ... tetap digunakan" is slightly clumsy; consider "tetap dipertahankan".
Item 4: "mau makan" is colloquial; "memakan" or "menerima" is more natural in a handbook.
Item 4: "pelet butiran" is redundant; use "granul" or "pelet".
Item 4: "dirangsang" for "promoted" is slightly off; "didorong" or "dipicu" fits better for algae growth.
Item 3: "hanya sedikit tercemar bahan organik" is acceptable but wordy; "rendah polutan organik" is more natural.

sewellia-lineolata.name: Reticulated Hillstream Loach
notes: Item 13: 'goldfish' translated as 'ikan mas koki'. Use 'ikan mas koki' only if that is meant; fine, but 'river manifold tank' is left as 'akuarium model river manifold'. Explain it in Indonesian or give a proper term.

Item 16: 'Pseudogastromyzon pun bisa kesulitan menunjukkan dominasinya' follows 'jika wilayah terbatas'. The English says 'if the latter resources are limited', meaning food and territory. Write 'jika pakan dan wilayah terbatas'.
Item 20: 'mencucup-cucup permukaan punggungnya' for 'mouthing of the dorsal surface' is awkward. Use 'menyentuh/mengisap-isap dengan mulut'.
Item 20: 'to dislodge her into open water' is rendered as 'terlepas ke kolom air'. Say 'perairan terbuka'.

Item 20: 'Pacaran ... mengepak-ngepakkan sirip' is fine, but 'fry' appears as 'burayak' in 'Initial reports ... recovering fry'. That is fine. 'woollen mops' became 'spawning mop dari benang wol'. Acceptable.
Item 6: 'arus deras sekali' for 'torrential' is awkward. Also 'air terjun kecil' for 'cascades' is okay. Rephrase the torrential part as 'arus sangat deras'.
Item 22: 'tuberkel' and 'balitorid' are fine. 'pipih ke bawah (depressed)' is OK. 'sirip dubur' for 'anal fin' is stiff. Use 'sirip anal'.
Item 22: 'one simple and 19–26 branched pectoral-fin rays' is rendered 'satu jari-jari sirip dada tunggal dan 19–26 bercabang'. Use 'satu jari-jari tak bercabang (simple)'.
Item 15: 'frozen spirulina brine shrimp' is rendered 'artemia beku yang diperkaya spirulina'. This is fine, but 'sayuran yang direbus sebentar (blanching)' is okay.
Item 3: 'Spesies Sewellia bisa dibilang yang paling mudah dipijahkan ... di antara semua loach' is fine. The 'tutup yang rapat mutlak diperlukan' repetition mirrors the source.

symphysodon-aequifasciatus.name: Discus
notes: Item 4: EN says 'around 6"' (≈15 cm) - this is fine, but the original 'few juvenile fish or a pair' fine; however item 1 says wild fish reach 14 cm and item 4 gives 15 cm, consistent with source, no change needed.
Item 8: 'Di antara semua discus, yang paling istimewa' loses 'kings of the discus fishes' (raja discus); consider 'Rajanya discus adalah varian "Royal"'.
Item 8: 'Royal asal Tefé ... dikenal sebagai yang paling cantik' drops 'legendarily'; add 'secara legendaris/dikenal luas'.
Item 8: 'yang di mata para penghobi jauh kurang menarik' - source says 'in our eyes' (neutral); 'kawin satu sama lain sebagai satu populasi' is acceptable but 'form a reproductive community' fine.
Item 8: 'Saat ini ikan-ikan tersebut berukuran 12-15 cm' - 'Currently' fine; but 'banyak di antaranya juga punya' changes 'additionally' slightly; ok.
Item 8: 'cincin iris kuning maupun merah' - 'maupun' implies both in same fish; use 'kuning atau merah'.
Item 2: 'mengikuti Rio Solimões' - source 'extends down'; use 'membentang di sepanjang Rio Solimões'. Also mixed 'Rio Putumayo' / 'Sungai Amazon' fine.

symphysodon-discus.name: Discus
notes: Item 6: "burayak" for fry is regional/less common among Indonesian hobbyists; "benih" or "anakan" is more common, and the text mixes "burayak" with "anakan" (item 9). Use one term consistently.
Items 2 and 9: "manfish" for Angelfish (Pterophyllum) is a common name, but "angelfish" is the more widely understood term; consider "ikan angelfish (manfish)".
Item 8: "yang sudah ahli" is awkward; use "hanya oleh ahli" or "hanya dapat dibedakan oleh orang yang berpengalaman".
Item 8: "musim kawin" for "breeding time" is inconsistent with "memijah" elsewhere; use "saat musim pemijahan".
Item 9: "mencabik 'makanan'" is too strong for "breaking off"; use "mengerat/menyobek sedikit 'makanan'".
Item 1: "dipopulerkan ke seluruh dunia" and "akuaris" are acceptable but "penghobi akuarium" is more natural.

synodontis-eupterus.name: Synodontis Featherfin
notes: Item 13: 'udang besar, udang kecil' for 'prawns, shrimps' adds an invented size distinction; use 'udang' / 'udang kecil'.
Item 20: 'kurus atau sangat kurus' is redundant for 'thin or emaciated'; use 'kurus atau sangat kurus kering' or just 'kurus kering'.
Item 16: 'quarrelsome' rendered as 'agresif' is slightly too strong; use 'suka berselisih' or 'galak'.
Item 12: 'bekas luka yang buruk' is awkward; use 'bekas luka yang jelek/permanen'. 'kayu bogwood/akar' is redundant.
Item 17: 'cichlid yang kekar' is odd; use 'cichlid bertubuh tangguh'.
Item 4: 'di farm' is awkward; use 'hasil budidaya (farm bred)'. Items 1 and 22 'farm budidaya ikan' could be 'tempat budidaya ikan'.

tanichthys-albonubes.name: White Cloud
notes: Item 20: "hide most of the time" is rendered "lebih sering bersembunyi"; this is weaker than the source, so use "hampir sepanjang waktu bersembunyi".
Item 28: "musim semi hingga musim gugur" is awkward for Indonesian readers, who have no such seasons; consider "sepanjang musim kawin (musim semi hingga musim gugur di habitat asalnya)".
Item 12: "African dwarf frog" is left in English; add a local term such as "katak kerdil Afrika" with the English name in brackets.
Item 27: "betina tampak bunting telur" is odd for fish; "betina tampak penuh telur" is more natural.

thayeria-boehlkei.name: Penguin Tetra
notes: Item 8: "sangat agresif" for "very boisterous" shifts the meaning. Boisterous means rowdy or very active, not aggressive. Use "sangat aktif/heboh".
Item 10: "pada sore atau malam hari" adds "atau malam". The source says only "in the evening", so use "pada sore hari".
Item 10: "sperma" for "milt" is acceptable, but "cairan sperma" or "air mani ikan" would read more naturally for fish.
Item 8: "Selalu beli dalam kelompok" leaves out the object, so it reads abruptly. Use "Selalu beli ikan ini dalam kelompok...".

thorichthys-meeki.name: Firemouth
notes: Item 7: "(dipakai seperti cetakan)" is added to the pipette instruction and isn't in the source. Remove it.
Item 11: "subopercle" and "preorbital" are left untranslated. Consider "suboperkulum" and "praorbital", or add a gloss.
Item 2: "Sungai Río Tonalá" says "river" twice (Sungai and Río). Use "Río Tonalá" or "Sungai Tonalá".

toxotes-jaculatrix.name: Ikan sumpit
notes: Item 1: "archerfish" is left in English in "jenis archerfish" and "di antara archerfish lainnya". Use "ikan sumpit" consistently.
Item 11: "dijual di Inggris" keeps the UK context, which is fine. "setup" could be "penataan" or "tata akuarium", but this is optional.

trichogaster-lalius.name: Colisa
notes: Item 3: 'Minimum tank size: 15 gallons (~60 litres)' is fine, but the 'Nitrate: less than 60' line is left without a unit (mg/L). Add the unit or keep as in the source.

Item 28: 'Nests ... reaching several inches across (roughly 7–15 cm)' is fine, but 'Mencabut tanaman karpet' etc. are OK. The real problem: 'Sirip perut' vs 'ventral' is mixed up, so 'touches her ventral side' became 'bagian perut betina'. This is acceptable, but 'menyentuh punggung atau ekor jantan' is fine too.
Item 10: 'sudah pas-pasan cukup' is awkward. Use 'cukup untuk sepasang, asalkan ditata dengan benar'.

Item 14: 'manfish' for angelfish is non-standard. Use 'angelfish' or 'ikan manfish/angel'. 'ikan mas koki' for goldfish is acceptable. 'corydoras pygmy' and 'rasbora harlequin' use inverted English order. Use 'rasbora harlequin' or 'Rasbora hengeli' consistently.
Item 9: 'sirip ekornya membulat hingga tegak lurus di ujungnya' is a poor rendering of 'rounded to truncate'. Use 'membulat hingga tumpul/terpancung'.
Item 17: 'pantulan cahaya dari dasar kaca' adds 'kaca' (glass) that is not in the source. Also 'Anacharis' and 'Elodea' are listed as two plants, as in the source.
Item 27: 'Jantan sama sekali tidak bisa lagi menerima keberadaan pasangannya' is stiff. Use 'tidak lagi menoleransi pasangannya'. 'Anakan gurami' mixes terms with 'burayak'. Keep one term.

Item 16: 'Suhu yang mematikan 50% populasi' is fine, but 'kematian hanya 1%' at 20 and 25 °C is faithfully kept. The listed range 20–26 °C against the 22–27 °C elsewhere is a source inconsistency, not a translation error.
Item 1: the 'Max size: 88 mm SL' line dropped '(3.5 in)', which is permitted. 'Pembiakan massal juga mungkin telah menyebarkan' is fine, so no change is needed here.

trichopodus-leerii.name: Sepat mutiara
notes: Item 8: 'Minimum tank size: 20 gallons (about 76 litres)' – 20 US gal is ~76 L, fine, but '40-gallon (about 150 litres)' is fine too; no issue here. Real issue: item 2 'Life expectancy: 4 to 5 years' vs item 1/21 '8 years' is a source inconsistency, translation faithful – ignore.

Item 6: 'sepat mutiara tumbuh baik, dan begitu pula di akuarium dengan kondisi serupa' is awkward and slightly changes meaning; rephrase to 'Di habitat aslinya yang penuh vegetasi... sepat mutiara berkembang baik di akuarium dengan kondisi serupa'.
Item 14: 'pakan kering beku (freeze-dried)' is a clumsy term; use 'pakan freeze-dried' or 'pakan beku-kering'. 'jentik kaca' for glass worms is okay but 'cacing kaca' is more common.
Item 15: 'it will become withdrawn' translated as 'menjadi pemalu' – better 'menarik diri/stres dan bersembunyi'.
Item 17/18: 'blander' translated as 'lebih pucat' is acceptable; 'Jantan dewasa jauh lebih berwarna' is awkward, use 'warnanya jauh lebih cerah'.

Item 19: 'air-powered filters' rendered 'filter bertenaga aerator' – use 'filter udara (filter busa/sponge berpenggerak udara)'. 'gaya berpelukan khas anabantoid' is stilted; use 'pelukan pemijahan khas anabantoid'. Also '6-8"' converted to 15–20 cm and '10"' to 25 cm are correct.
Item 20: 'sirip perut ... berbentuk seperti antena peraba' – 'antena' is odd for fish; use 'sungut/filamen peraba'. Also 'after four days' ambiguity fine.
Item 22: 'efek seperti kerang mutiara' for mother-of-pearl should be 'kilau mutiara/induk mutiara', not 'kerang mutiara'. 'Bagian bawah kepala' fine.
Item 4: 'Pulau Sumatra serta Kalimantan' acceptable; 'Hampir Terancam' good.
Item 7: 'Panjang standar: 120 mm SL' – 'SL' redundant; fine otherwise.

trichopodus-trichopterus.name: Sepat rawa
notes: Item 7: "omnivora yang cukup umum" is a loose rendering of "fairly generalised omnivores". Use "omnivora generalis" or "pemakan segala yang tidak spesialis".
Item 8: "loricariid" is left in English. Consider "ikan lorikarid (suckermouth catfish)" or "ikan sapu-sapu dan kerabatnya" so readers recognise it.

trigonostigma-espei.name: Rasbora Lambchop
notes: Item 10: 'sebaiknya pada sore atau malam hari' – English says only 'preferably in the evening'; 'atau malam hari' is added.
Item 10: 'kesadahan 1–5°H' – use 'dGH' for consistency; '°H' is ambiguous.
Item 10: 'ganti air besar ... dengan air yang lebih dingin' – fine in meaning, but 'peternak' for breeders is odd; use 'pembiak' or 'penghobi'.
Item 10: "sejumlah 'latihan'" for 'dry runs' is unclear; use something like 'percobaan/gerakan pemijahan palsu tanpa telur'.
Item 10: 'Alas plastik jenis rumput' fine, but 'Rupanya perilaku memijah' is stiff; 'jumlah telurnya juga lebih sedikit' fine.
Item 3: 'dasarnya dipenuhi daun gugur' – the English says the substrate is scattered with leaves; 'dipenuhi' overstates it; use 'bertebaran'.
Item 1: 'cyprinid' left untranslated; Indonesian hobby usage is 'ikan cyprinid/suku Cyprinidae' – acceptable but 'lambchop' in quotes is not explained.
Item 5: 'Daun boleh dibiarkan ... atau diangkat dan diganti' is fine; 'Pilihan dekorasi tidak terlalu menentukan' is awkward; use 'tidak terlalu krusial'.

Item 8: 'ikan hias paling populer' – 'in the hobby' is rendered loosely; and 'catfish, loach' are untranslated trade terms where 'lele-lelean/ikan sapu-sapu' type terms are not intended; 'gugup' for nervous is odd, use 'stres/penakut'.

trigonostigma-hengeli.name: Rasbora hengeli
notes: Item 4: "in the current post" is dropped. Add something like "dalam artikel ini" or "yang dibahas di sini" before the Trigonopoma example.
Item 2: "buah alder (alder cone)" is slightly odd. "kerucut alder" or "kerucut pohon alder" is more accurate than "buah", because alder cones are catkin-like cones.

Item 1: "tubuh bagian depan T. espei berwarna (pada T. hengeli terang/transparan)" is clumsy and hard to parse. Rephrase it, for example "bagian depan tubuh T. espei berwarna, sedangkan pada T. hengeli terang/transparan".

trigonostigma-heteromorpha.name: Rasbora Harlequin
notes: Item 5: 'Kalimantan' for 'Borneo' narrows the meaning (Kalimantan is only the Indonesian part). Use 'Pulau Borneo (Kalimantan)' or 'Borneo'.
Item 11: 'Pilihan dekorasi tidak terlalu menentukan' is stiff. 'Pilihan dekorasi tidak terlalu penting' reads more naturally.
Item 8: 'Sebagai patokan jumlah ikan' is an added phrase that is not in the source. It can be dropped.
Item 22: 'peternak' for 'breeders' reads as livestock farmers. 'Pembudidaya' or 'breeder' is the usual hobby term.

vittina-waigiensis.name: Nerite Waigiensis
notes: Item 3: "Semua hal yang umumnya berlaku untuk siput nerite juga berlaku untuk perawatan spesies ini" is slightly redundant; simplify to "Perawatannya sama seperti siput nerite pada umumnya".
Item 5: "ahli yang kompeten" is a bit stiff; "ahli yang berkualifikasi" or just "ahli" is more natural.

Item 5: "Spesimen tipe yang ditampilkan di basis data ilmiah WoRMS warna dan bentuknya lebih mirip..." has awkward syntax; add "yang" or "dalam hal", e.g. "...dari segi warna dan bentuk lebih mirip...".
Item 5: "Semua V. waigiensis dewasa tidak memiliki ujung cangkang" should read "Semua siput V. waigiensis dewasa tidak memiliki ujung cangkang (puncak cangkangnya hilang)" for clarity.

xiphophorus-hellerii.name: Ikan Pedang
notes: Item 1: 'bentuk ikan hias yang membingungkan saking beragamnya' is awkward and over-translates 'bewildering array'; use 'beragam bentuk ikan hias yang sulit dihitung'.
Item 3: 'garis tengah lateral' for 'mid-lateral stripe' is confusing; 'dusky' rendered as 'gelap' is fine, but write 'garis lateral tengah' and 'garis kemerahan di atas dan di bawah garis tersebut'.

Item 19: 'posisi sirip dada lebih ke atas' for 'dorsal position of the pectoral fin' is okay, but 'tubuhnya berbentuk torpedo (fusiform)' adds 'torpedo' not in source; use 'berbentuk fusiform (ramping memanjang)'.

Item 26: 'Watak' for 'Temper' and 'Pilihan yang disarankan: platy' lose 'southern platyfish' (Xiphophorus maculatus); 'cupang (Betta)' is fine but 'Kekurangan pakan' fine. Name 'southern platy' rather than plain 'platy'.

Item 27: 'jantan "bongsor"' for 'real bulls' and 'peternak' for breeders; 'early/late males' rendered as 'jantan cepat/lambat' is non-standard; use 'jantan dewasa dini (early) dan lambat (late)' consistently and 'pembiak' instead of 'peternak'.
Item 31: source text is truncated ('sneakers',' and 'for months,'); the Indonesian mirrors it, but ensure the sentence is completed/ consistent with the source.

Item 33: 'memijahkan' is used for livebearers, which do not spawn; use 'mengawinkan' or 'membiakkan'. Also 'melahirkan sampai 9 kali berturut-turut' for 9 broods is fine, but 'mikroworm' and 'blackworm' should be 'cacing mikro' and 'cacing hitam'.
Item 36: 'Sumber aslinya menyebutkan' still references the source page, contrary to the neutral-writing rule; rephrase to 'Ada keterangan yang menyebut ... namun itu keliru'.
Item 2/13: 'Harapan hidup' for 'Life expectancy' is acceptable, but 'Area berenang' is nonstandard; use 'Lapisan air' or 'Zona berenang'.
Item 12: 'ukuran alas' conveys 'surface dimensions' ok; but 'kutu air' for Daphnia (item 21, 23) is better as 'daphnia' to avoid confusion with other pests.

xiphophorus-maculatus.name: Platy
